title: (Senior) Toezichthouder Digital Operational Resilience (DORA) Capital Markets
description:
Als (Senior) Toezichthouder DORA binnen het team Market Infrastructure of Trading Venues speel je een cruciale rol in het toezicht op de digitale weerbaarheid van de kapitaalmarkten. Jij beoordeelt of handelsplatformen, proprietary trading firms en clearing‑ en settlementinstellingen voldoen aan de Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA), en of hun IT‑processen voldoende robuust, veilig en toekomstbestendig zijn. DORA vraagt dat instellingen hun IT‑risico’s effectief beheersen, incidenten snel en transparant oplossen, regelmatig testen of systemen bestand zijn tegen cyberdreigingen en risico’s in de keten en uitbesteding scherp onder controle houden. Jij helpt hen daarbij én houdt scherp toezicht op naleving. Samen met je collega’s ontwikkel en borg je een impactvolle toezichtstrategie voor digitale weerbaarheid binnen de kapitaalmarktinfrastructuur. Je leidt onderzoeken, gaat in gesprek met instellingen en stakeholders, en volgt technologische en marktontwikkelingen op de voet. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met nationale en internationale toezichthouders zoals DNB en ESMA en ben je een stevige gesprekspartner voor marktpartijen. Je draagt bovendien bij aan beleidsontwikkeling en kunt je expertise inzetten bij projecten binnen verschillende teams. Kortom: jouw werk heeft directe impact op de stabiliteit en digitale veerkracht van de financiële markten.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Toezicht houden op de digitale weerbaarheid van de kapitaalmarkten

  • Onderzoek leiden en uitvoeren naar DORA‑compliance bij kapitaalmarktinstellingen

  • Uitwerken van een meerjarige DORA‑strategie

  • Fungeren als aanspreekpunt voor (internationale) marktpartijen

  • Bijdragen aan beleidsontwikkeling binnen kapitaalmarkten

  • Samenwerken met toezichthouders zoals DNB en ESMA

title: Data Engineer Kapitaalmarkten
description:
Als allround Data Engineer binnen de afdeling Datagedreven Kapitaalmarkten (DAK) ontwerp, bouw en beheer je betrouwbare datapipelines en datasets voor het toezicht op de kapitaalmarkten. Daarnaast help je onze ontwikkel- en deploymentprocessen en het gebruik van Databricks verder te professionaliseren. Je ontsluit, structureert en prepareert gegevens voor data-analisten, toezichthouders en andere gebruikers. Binnen onze Azure-cloudomgeving werk je met grote hoeveelheden gestructureerde en ongestructureerde data, variërend van miljoenen tot miljarden records. De gegevens bevinden zich onder meer in Databricks, SQL-databases en Azure Storage. Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare ETL-processen en zorgt dat data vindbaar, controleerbaar en geschikt is voor analyse en toezicht. Je verbetert de ontwikkel- en deploymentprocessen met versiebeheer, geautomatiseerd testen en CI/CD in Azure DevOps. Met Declarative Automation Bundles leg je Databricks-code, configuraties en resources vast en deploy je deze gecontroleerd naar verschillende omgevingen. Hierbij werk je aan herhaalbare en beter beheersbare wijzigingen en deployments. Bij het ontwikkelen van dataoplossingen pas je de geldende kaders voor security, privacy en governance toe. Je draagt bij aan monitoring en kostenbewust gebruik van het Databricks-platform, in samenwerking met de verantwoordelijke platform-, architectuur- en securityspecialisten. Daarnaast ontwikkel je duurzame dataproducten en draag je actief bij aan kennisdeling, innovatie en standaardisatie binnen het team.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Ontwikkelen en beheren van processen voor data-ingestie, transformatie en verwerking binnen onze Azure-cloudomgeving en op het Databricks-platform met onder andere Databricks Jobs, Azure Data Factory en PySpark/SQL.

title: Senior contractmanager IT
description:

Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat contracten effectief worden beheerd, bewaakt en nageleefd om optimale resultaten te behalen.   • Beheren van risico’s en oplossen van contractuele vraagstukken gedurende de looptijd van contracten.

  • Opstellen van heldere en tijdige contractrapportages voor management

title: Toezichthouder cybersecurity Crypto
description:

The Opportunity   As a Strategic Customer Success Manager at FICO, you'll be a trusted executive partner to some of our most important customers, driving transformational outcomes and sustainable growth across a portfolio of high-value accounts. title: Account Manager, Large Enterprise Commercial
description: The Company  PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.  We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.  We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.  Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. title: (Senior) Customer Experience & Loyalty Manager (m/w/d)
description: Als global tätiges EnerTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Energieversorgung, Technologie und Services. Unser Ziel ist es, mehr Menschen Zugang zu modernen Energielösungen zu ermöglichen. Dafür bieten wir Stromtarife aus 100% erneuerbaren Energien an, installieren Wärmepumpen und entwickeln smarte Tarife.       Dabei sind unsere  Ökostromtarife nur die Basis . Bereits seit 2022 installieren wir Wärmepumpen-Komplettlösungen mit  eigenen Fachkräften . Außerdem arbeiten wir aktiv an der flächendeckenden Einführung von Smart Metern,  Elektromobilitätslösungen  und der eigenen  Stromerzeugung aus Wind- und Sonnenenergie .       Das schaffen wir allerdings nicht alleine, sondern dazu brauchen wir dich! Werde Teil unseres Teams und fordere den Status Quo heraus. Mit Energie, die gut für den Planeten ist und gut für dein Karma. 💚  Finde jetzt deinen Traumjob und werde Teil der Energierevolution von Octopus Energy Germany.     Als Customer Experience Manager (m/w/d) bist du dafür verantwortlich, die langfristige Bindung und Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden und Kundinnen zu stärken, indem du Strategien entwickelst und umsetzt, die das Kundenerlebnis kontinuierlich verbessern und die Kundenloyalität steigern.       Deine Aufgaben    Entwicklung und Implementierung neuer Strategien und Ansätze zur Steigerung der Kundenbindung und -loyalität   Erstellung und Optimierung von Kundenkommunikation (z.B. E-Mail-Marketing)   Durchführung von A/B-Tests zur Evaluierung und Verbesserung von Kundenbindungsmaßnahmen   Überwachung und Analyse von Kundenfeedback, um kontinuierlich Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und die Kundenbindung zu fördern   Quantitative Analyse und Auswertung von Kundendaten (mit Excel, SQL, BI-Tools, ggf. Python) zur Identifikation von Trends und Optimierungspotenzialen   Regelmäßige Erstellung von Reports und Dashboards zur Erfolgskontrolle und kontinuierlichen Optimierung von Retention-Maßnahmen   Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Sales und Produktteams, um eine ganzheitliche Kundenerfahrung sicherzustellen        Das bringst du mit     Mind. 2-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in den Bereichen Customer Experience oder Kundenbindung - vorzugsweise in einem schnell wachsenden, dynamischen Umfeld   Ein Gespür für die richtige Sprache und ein Auge für Layout: Du hast ein gutes Sprachgefühl, setzt gerne Kundenkommunikation auf und passt diese auf Basis von Kundenfeedback kontinuierlich an   Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Analysen und Konzepte verständlich zu präsentieren   Ausgeprägtes strategisches und analytisches Denkvermögen, um Prozesse datengetrieben zu optimieren und nachhaltiges Wachstum zu fördern   Hands-on-Mentalität: Du bist in der Lage, Daten zu analysieren, Prozesse zu gestalten und operative Themen eigenständig zu steuern   Erfahrungen in der Datenanalyse, idealerweise mit Excel / Google Sheets und/oder erste Erfahrungen mit SQL und die Bereitschaft, diese Fähigkeiten weiter auszubauen   Deutschkenntnisse

You read behaviour and act on where customers stall or grow.  You think in systems. You would rather build a repeatable, automated flow than run another one-off campaign. Je zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen, houdt overzicht en schakelt met de teams die het werk uitvoeren. Je zit er bovenop als iets niet loopt en zorgt dat het wordt opgelost.  Je bent voor klanten het vaste aanspreekpunt en weet wat er speelt. Tegelijkertijd zie je waar dingen beter kunnen en pak je dat op.   Wat ga je doen?     Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dienstverlening richting jouw klanten.  Je bewaakt de SLA’s en volgt ze op.  Je schakelt met operations, logistiek en support.  Je signaleert knelpunten en lost ze op met de juiste teams.  Je bereidt service reviews voor en voert ze uit.  Je draagt verbeteringen aan in processen en samenwerking.  Je houdt overzicht en zorgt dat acties worden opgepakt.     Vereisten    Wie ben jij?     HBO werk- en denkniveau  Ervaring met servicemanagement of een vergelijkbare rol  Overzicht houden in een omgeving waar meerdere teams en processen samenkomen  Ervaring met SLA’s en het bewaken van serviceafspraken  Duidelijk en direct communiceren, ook als iets niet loopt zoals afgesproken  Structuur aanbrengen en zorgen dat afspraken worden nagekomen  Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de kwaliteit van dienstverlening  In staat om teams en klanten mee te krijgen in wat nodig is     Wat bieden wij?     Een salaris tussen €4.400 en €5.100 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.  Een leaseauto of volledige reiskostenvergoeding.  Standplaats Nieuwegein met de mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken(80% kantoor - 20% vanuit huis).  Een functie voor 32 - 40 uur p.w.  Een rol waarin je direct invloed hebt op hoe nieuwe klanten starten bij Circular IT group.  Samenwerken met teams uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie, van sales tot operations.  Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals bijv. reisvergoeding en extra vakantiedagen.    Bij Circular IT Group geloven we dat een divers team zorgt voor betere resultaten en een fijnere werkplek. Daarom moedigen we iedereen aan om te solliciteren, ongeacht achtergrond, gender, leeftijd, overtuiging of andere eigenschappen die jou uniek maken.  Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen, maar denk je dat deze functie wel bij je past? Dan horen we nog steeds graag van je.  Wil jij deel uitmaken van een groeiend bedrijf waar je écht impact maakt?  Solliciteer nu en versterk ons team in Nieuwegein!

Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie die Fähigkeit, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen erfolgreich aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln.  Analytisches Denkvermögen und Erfahrung im Umgang mit KPI-basierter Steuerung.  Hohe Kommunikations- und Konfliktlösungskompetenz sowie ein souveränes Auftreten gegenüber internen und externen Stakeholdern.  Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.  Gute Kenntnisse in CRM-Systemen und den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen. title: Senior Project Manager
description: Customer Delivery Manager - SaaS Implementation & Customer Success!    • Join a growing SaaS technology business with ambitious growth plans    • Take ownership of end-to-end customer implementations and drive customer success    • Work directly with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to shape the delivery function      An exciting opportunity has opened for a Customer Delivery Manager to join a growing SaaS technology organisation, taking ownership of customer delivery, implementation and long-term customer success. This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys managing complex projects, building strong customer relationships and ensuring technology solutions deliver real value.     As Customer Delivery Manager, you will lead the end-to-end implementation process, ensuring customers are onboarded successfully, projects are delivered on time and within scope, and expectations are managed throughout the customer journey. Working closely with customers and internal teams across Product, Development and Customer Care, you will play a key role in delivering a seamless customer experience and driving adoption of the organisation’s SaaS solutions.     Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer (COO), you will have the opportunity to influence how customer delivery operates across the business. From managing multiple implementations and coordinating stakeholders to optimising onboarding processes and establishing delivery KPIs, you will help build a scalable delivery function that supports customer satisfaction, retention and business growth.     This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Customer Delivery, Project Management or Customer Success professional who wants to take ownership, improve processes and make a tangible impact within an ambitious technology business.      Why This Role Stands Out   • End-to-end ownership: Lead customer implementations from onboarding to successful delivery. • Customer relationships: Build strong stakeholder relationships and manage the customer journey.  • Leadership exposure: Work directly with the COO to shape delivery strategy.  • Cross-functional impact: Collaborate with Product, Development and Customer Care.  • Process optimisation: Improve onboarding and implementation processes.  • Customer adoption: Drive engagement through training and ongoing support.  • Measurable results: Track KPIs to improve delivery performance and customer experience. • Career growth: Develop professionally within a growing SaaS business.      What You Bring   • 5+ years of experience in Customer Delivery, Project Management or Customer Success within a SaaS or technology-driven environment.  • Proven experience managing multiple customer implementations and delivering projects on time and within scope.  • A strong understanding of SaaS implementation processes, including data migration, integrations, onboarding and user training.      Package & Benefits   • Up to €80,000 base salary + more

title: Head of Customer Services
description: Over de functie   De Head of Customer Services is verantwoordelijk voor de volledige klantreis, vanaf implementatie tot en met structureel klantensucces. De belangrijkste opgave is het ontwikkelen van een Customer Services-organisatie die:   sterk klantgericht is  operationeel excellent presteert  commercieel gezond is  kan meegroeien met de verdere adoptie van Isah10  meer gestandaardiseerd en schaalbaar werkt, zonder klantgerichtheid te verliezen  AI effectief inzet om productiviteit en kwaliteit te verhogen      De succesvolle kandidaat brengt meer structuur, voorspelbaarheid en accountability in de dienstverlening, zonder het ondernemende en pragmatische karakter van Isah uit het oog te verliezen.  De rol vraagt nadrukkelijk om iemand die strategie weet te vertalen naar concrete uitvoering. Sinds de oprichting in 1987 ontwikkelt Isah ERP-oplossingen die specifiek zijn ontworpen voor industriële MKB-bedrijven. De software ondersteunt de volledige bedrijfsketen, waaronder productie, logistiek, inkoop, finance en projectmanagement. Wat Isah kenmerkt, is de combinatie van diepe kennis van de maakindustrie en langdurige klantrelaties. Veel medewerkers hebben zelf ervaring binnen de maakindustrie en begrijpen daardoor de processen, dynamiek en cultuur van klanten. Isah spreekt letterlijk de taal van haar klanten.     De oplossingen zijn modulair opgebouwd en sluiten aan op uiteenlopende productieomgevingen, waaronder make-to-order en engineer-to-order. Daarmee helpt Isah klanten hun operationele efficiëntie te verbeteren, real-time inzicht te creëren en hun onderneming schaalbaar te organiseren. title: Manager Service Delivery Management
description: Functieomschrijving     Bouw mee aan de volgende fase van Managed Services    Ben jij een ervaren leider in Service Delivery Management en klaar om landelijke impact te maken binnen één van de grootste Managed Service Providers van Nederland? Wil jij een team van Service Delivery Managers verder ontwikkelen, klantwaarde vergroten en bijdragen aan de groei van een organisatie die volop in beweging is? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.  Bij Interstellar bouwen we iedere dag aan betrouwbare, voorspelbare en hoogwaardige IT-dienstverlening voor onze klanten. Vanuit onze visie"We Power Progress, Together" combineren we landelijke slagkracht met specialistische kennis, ondernemerschap en langdurige klantrelaties. Service Delivery Management speelt daarin een sleutelrol. Niet alleen als bewaker van dienstverlening, maar juist als versneller van klantwaarde, klanttevredenheid en commerciële groei.  Als Manager Service Delivery Management geef je leiding aan het landelijke team van Service Delivery Managers. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere professionalisering van het vakgebied, de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening en de ontwikkeling van onze mensen. Daarbij zorg je voor een uniforme werkwijze, duidelijke governance en een cultuur waarin eigenaarschap, samenwerking en continue verbetering centraal staan.  Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor klanten, directie en management. Je begrijpt hoe complexe Managed Services-organisaties functioneren en weet operationele prestaties te verbinden aan klantbeleving, contractresultaat en commerciële kansen.  Je rapporteert aan de VP Managed Operations & Delivery en werkt nauw samen met Delivery Management, Sales, Finance en de verschillende operationele teams binnen Interstellar.    Wat ga je doen?    Als Manager Service Delivery Management ben je verantwoordelijk voor:     De integrale aansturing, coaching en ontwikkeling van het landelijke SDM-team.   Het borgen van een uniforme werkwijze rondom service reviews, governance, rapportages, escalaties en contractmanagement.   Het verhogen van klanttevredenheid, klantloyaliteit en contractretentie.   Het ondersteunen van commerciële groei door het actief ontwikkelen van up- en cross-sell kansen binnen bestaande klantrelaties.   Het bewaken en verbeteren van contractperformance, marges en financiële resultaten binnen de SDM-portefeuille.   Het verder ontwikkelen van Service Delivery Management als strategische discipline binnen Interstellar.   Het versterken van de samenwerking tussen Service Delivery, Operations, Sales, Finance en de specialistische teams.   Het stimuleren van een cultuur waarin klantwaarde, eigenaarschap en continue verbetering centraal staan.      Meer weten over werken bij Interstellar?   We kunnen je hier natuurlijk alles vertellen over onze cultuur, collega’s, events, ontwikkelmogelijkheden en hoe je eerste weken eruitzien. Maar eerlijk is eerlijk: dat zie je beter op onze werkenbij-site .    Hoe is het om bij ons te werken? Lees

title: Technical Account Manager
description: At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections.  Mindbody equips wellness entrepreneurs with technology to support thriving businesses and create exceptional experiences. Innovation and curiosity drive our culture, connecting businesses and individuals through cutting-edge solutions. Join us if you're passionate about enhancing wellness through technology.   JOB FAMILY SUMMARY:   The Account and Implementation Management Team provides a wide range of services to Mindbody customers who wish to engage with a single-point-of-contact for their account and complex technical management needs. The team also provides support for multiple types of one-time project engagements from site redesigns to mass data changes within the software.   JOB SUMMARY:   A Technical Account Manager (TAM) provides technical and account management support to their assigned base by gaining a deep understanding of a customer's business model, data, and integration needs to develop solutions that meet the customer's needs within the software and improve efficiencies. The incumbent is required to develop relationships with both customers and internal resources to ensure a customer's success, drawing on strong technical fluency (APIs, SQL, data analysis) alongside account management skill. The TAM is responsible for managing the customer experience by educating customers on best practices, acting as their liaison for all things Mindbody — including technical and integration matters — and delivering services in a way that our customers are delighted to do business with Mindbody.   MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:     Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience, preferably in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering) or equivalent hands-on experience. Project management or coordination experience preferred.  Prior experience with Mindbody's core software products is a nice to have; strong technical aptitude and ability to ramp quickly on new platforms and technical stacks is required. title: Automotive Dealer Activation Manager
description: At UVeye, we're on a mission to redefine vehicle safety and reliability on a global scale. Founded in 2016, we pioneered the world's first fully automated suite of vehicle inspection systems. At the heart of this innovation lies our advanced AI-centric technology, representing the pinnacle of computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI within the automotive sector.  With over $380M in funding and strategic partnerships with industry giants such as Toyota, Amazon, General Motors, Volvo, and Hertz, our technology is utilized in manufacturing plants, dealerships, wholesale auctions, delivery fleets, seaports, and more. Our growing global team of 250+ employees is committed to creating a workplace that celebrates diversity, encourages teamwork, and strives for excellence.  The  Dealer Activation Manager  is responsible for executing UVeye’s onboarding, relaunch, and enablement processes to ensure every dealer achieves early adoption, operational consistency, and long-term success. This role delivers the structured 90-day activation experience, partners closely with CSMs, and drives the hands-on work that accelerates time-to-value at the dealership. title: Generative Media Engineer, AI Social - US
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

AI Social is one of the most ambitious products we've ever shipped. An AI agent that produces on-brand Instagram carousels and reels for every Luxury Presence customer, from raw input data to finished media. It isn't LLMs writing code. It's LLMs designing, choosing the photo, voicing the script, picking the cuts, and composing the final frame.

As the Generative Media Engineer on AI Social, you own the render pipeline, the prompts and agent loops that drive it, and the visual quality of what ships. Product and content strategy partners set the direction; engineering and design peers ship alongside you. This is an unusual role at the intersection of code, design, AI, and social media. You don't fit the normal engineering mold, that's the point.

Skills and experience

  • Solid working knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js. You're comfortable shipping production code and you're ready to grow into our stack.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-driven systems. Prompts, structured outputs, tool-calling, agent loops, evals.
  • At least one shipped piece of generative media in image, video, voice, or music that someone other than you has seen and used.
  • A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates both technical depth and design sensibility.
  • Bonus: a personal creator practice somewhere. A feed, a portfolio, a side project, a YouTube channel, an Are.na. Public, ongoing, under your own name. You understand the medium because you've lived in it.
  • Formal or self-taught grounding in design, visual art, film, or motion.
  • Comfort moving between exploratory PoC work and shipped-to-customers polish, with judgment about which mode is appropriate when.

Technical fluency with AI tools

  • You're already using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI-assisted development tools in your daily workflow. We're a Claude Code shop and we expect you to be fluent.
  • Familiarity with MCPs and how tools like Figma, Notion, and Linear connect into AI-assisted workflows. You understand how these tools and integrations fit together and can help the team get more out of them.
  • Beyond fluency, you're a dabbler and experimenter. You try new prompts, push their limits, and share what you learn. You have opinions about where the medium is headed.

title: Research Scientist, Protein Design & Engineering

About us

We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient.

If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it.

You'll engineer proteins to carry out useful chemistry, combining enzyme discovery, directed evolution, and experimental characterisation. You'll own the experimental cycle: choosing starting points, building variant libraries, developing screens, and establishing which changes improve function and why.

This is a hands-on role working closely with our computational and ML teams. You'll test designed proteins at the bench, use experimental results to guide subsequent rounds, and develop enzymes with the activity, selectivity, and stability needed for their intended application. There’s no fixed screening pipeline to inherit — you'll help decide how we build it.

What you'll do

  • Design and run protein engineering campaigns, from initial enzyme selection and library design through screening and charact

title: Orbital Analyst
description:
Orbital Analyst

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across Europe, South America, Africa and Australia. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, Innovate UK and the European Innovation Council.

Position Overview

You’ll be the operationally responsive member of the Astrodynamics team. You’ll take on a wide range of tasks, from producing analysis to demonstrate Foundational’s world leading capabilities, through customer facing discussions with the business development team to supporting customers with operational issues or special requirements. Expect to also be a key point of contact for our ground station teams to help ensure smooth functioning of our tracking network.

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investis

Wij zijn voor de Rijksinspectie Digitale Infrastructuur (RDI) op zoek naar een ervaren Projectleider. De RDI zet zich in voor een veilig verbonden Nederland en werkt aan actuele thema’s zoals cyberveiligheid, digitale weerbaarheid, AI, 5G en digitale infrastructuur.

De opdracht vindt plaats binnen de directie Digitale Weerbaarheid en richt zich op de organisatie van de NISDUC 2027 (NIS Directive User Community), een internationaal congres op het gebied van digitale weerbaarheid, cybersecurity en toezicht. Tijdens dit congres komen toezichthouders, overheden en professionals uit Nederland, België en Luxemburg samen om kennis en ervaringen uit te wisselen rondom onder meer NIS2 en cybersecurity.

Als Projectleider ben je verantwoordelijk voor de inhoudelijke en organisatorische aansturing van het congres en zorg je voor een succesvolle realisatie van het programma en de samenwerking met alle betrokken partijen.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je voert de projectleiding over het volledige programma van NISDUC 2027.

  • Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de organisatie van het internationale cybersecuritycongres.

  • Je ontwikkelt, beheert en vult de verschillende programmalijnen en tracks.

  • Je stemt af met betrokken overheidsorganisaties, toezichthouders en partners.

  • Je organiseert internationale kennisuitwisseling en samenwerking binnen het congresprogramma.

  • Je stuurt het betrokken evenementenbureau aan.

  • Je bewaakt planning, kwaliteit, voortgang en resultaten van het congres.

  • Je draagt zorg voor een professioneel en inhoudelijk sterk programma rondom digitale weerbaarheid en cybersecurity


Wat vragen wij?

Eisen:

  • Je hebt een afgeronde hbo-opleiding.

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervari

title: General Manager
description: Hos Sauna85 skaber vi rum til en pause fra hverdagen. Bag hver saunagus står et hold af mennesker, praktiske opgaver, der skal løses, og små detaljer, der gør oplevelsen bedre.  Vi søger en General Manager, der vil tage ansvar for den daglige drift, koordineringen af vores gusmestre og vores kundeservice. Administration:  Lønadministration, kontoropgaver og løbende arbejde i vores bookingsystem Ferb og øvrige tekniske systemer. Nye lokationer:  Undersøge muligheder og drive dialog, ansøgninger og opfølgning i forbindelse med nye lokationer.   Saunagus:  Afholde 12 faste gus om måneden som en del af din arbejdstid. Vi sørger for oplæring.   Opgaver undervejs:  Hjælpe med blandt andet events og andre opgaver, der opstår i en virksomhed i udvikling.       Om dig   Du tænker strategisk, arbejder organiseret og er hands-on. Du kan skabe overblik og holde driften kørende, samtidig med at du gerne tager fat – også når glemmekassen skal tømmes, panten skal afleveres, eller personalerummet trænger til at blive ryddet op.  Du har gerne erfaring med kundeservice, bookingsystemer, vagtplanlægning og koordinering af et team. Du er praktisk anlagt og trives med at finde løsninger, når noget ikke fungerer.  Vi forestiller os, at du:   Arbejder selvstændigt og følger opgaver til dørs.  Kan prioritere, når flere ting kræver din opmærksomhed.  Kommunikerer tydeligt og venligt med både gæster og gusmestre.  Har let ved at sætte dig ind i digitale systemer.  Trives med en hverdag, der både foregår ved computeren og ude på lokationerne.  Taler og skriver dansk og engelsk.   Du behøver ikke have erfaring som gusmester. Vi tilbyder uddannelse og oplæring, så du kan blive tryg i rollen.      Hos os får du   Du får stor indflydelse på den daglige drift og mulighed for at være med til at udvikle nye sauna-lokationer. Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen, primært på hverdage i dagtimerne, med planlagte gus. De 12 månedlige gus er inkluderet i arbejdstiden, som fordeles mellem administration, koordinering og praktiske opgaver. Du löst eskalierte Anrufe beim ersten Kontakt und arbeitest auf das vereinbarte Ziel des Teams hin.    Du baust ein engagiertes Team auf, entwickelst es weiter und bindest es langfristig, gemessen an Mitarbeiterbefragungen und Fluktuation.    Du stellst neue Teammitglieder ein und arbeitest sie so ein, dass sie bis zum Ende ihrer Probezeit sicher am Telefon sind.    Du planst das Arbeitsaufkommen so, dass Anrufe und Rückmeldungen in allen Kanälen abgedeckt sind.    Du etablierst klare Abläufe und Prozesse für das Team in Österreich.        Deine Führungskraft vereinbart konkrete Ziele für diese Kennz

Därför erbjuder de inte bara marknadens bästa lasermaskiner, utan en helhetslösning med utbildning, affärsutveckling, marknadsföring och livstids rådgivning till kunderna.     Som Account Manager blir du en del av ett tight team på 7 personer med stark gemenskap där dina åsikter och idéer värdesätts högt. Du kliver in i en mycket viktig tillväxtroll där du steg för steg bygger upp din egen kundportfölj och i praktiken driver ditt eget "bolag i bolaget". Din roll som Account Manager innebär ansvar för hela försäljningscykeln - från första kontakt till avslutad affär samt ett långsiktigt relationsbyggande. Du kommer in till en bransch med enorm potential och du kommer arbeta aktivt med att bearbeta nya och befintliga kunder över hela Sverige. För att ge dig de bästa förutsättningarna erbjuder Synos Medical en trygg onboarding och en kontinuerlig, fördjupad säljträning som löper under dina två första år.     För att passa i rollen hos Synos tror vi att du är nyfiken, har en förmåga att jobba ihärdigt och har god affärsmässighet. Du är också kommunikativ och har ett stort resultatfokus. I rollen förekommer även en del resande till kunder runtom i landet.      Arbetsuppgifter   Rollen innebär att driva hela säljprocessen från första kontakt till avslut genom hög aktivitet, relationsbyggande och demonstrationer av Synos lasermaskiner runt om i Sverige. Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat vara att:   Boka och genomföra kundmöten och aktivt arbeta för att identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter, både hos nya och befintliga kunder.  Bygga långsiktiga relationer och hjälpa kliniker med deras affärsutveckling  På sikt genomföra presentationer och produktdemonstrationer  Arbeta strukturerat med dokumentation och CRM-verktyg       Vi söker dig som    Har grundläggande erfarenhet av försäljning eller B2B-försäljning  Goda kunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift  Innehav av B-körkort  Starkt personligt driv, ihärdighet och vilja att ständigt lära sig       Det är meriterande om du har    Erfarenhet från skönhets- eller klinikbranschen       För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:    Optimistisk  Målmedveten  Social  Ansvarstagande  Respektfull       Vår rekryteringsprocess   Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.     Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsproce

title: Strategic Account Manager - Tokyo
description: About Agoda   At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.       Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.     No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.    *Native/Fluent Japanese Language Level Required for this Position*    Strategic Accounts Management Team     Agoda is a travel booking platform and accommodation is at our core. As our accommodation partners are a key to our success, we work hard to ensure their success. That is why the Strategic Accounts Management (SAM) team in Agoda specializes in account management. We serve as consultants, offering strategic advice on how best to excel on Agoda’s commercial platform. We are direct contributors to what makes Agoda one of the market leaders because we understand accommodation needs and offer innovative solutions. From Bangkok to London and beyond, our team has footprints in over 50 locations around the world. With the help of industry-leading technology, we work and collaborate globally to bring together the best ideas from diverse perspectives. The SAM team invests in long-term relationships that spans borders and cultures and results in incredible value for Agoda, our partners, and our customers.        The Opportunity:        As a    Strategic Account Manager,    you will be the main contact between our accommodation partners and Agoda, with the responsibility of nurturing the relationship with our key supply partners and driving mutual growth. A key responsibility in developing our business is the ability to identify and acquire new sources of supply and product offerings within an assigned territory while maintaining existing relationships.         In this Role, you’ll get to:         Develop long lasting relationships with key supply partners to enable Agoda’s growth in the region       Maintain regular and meaningful engagement with Agoda’s key supply partners       Analyze large datasets to propose tailor-made solutions to Agoda’s supply partners       Leverage analytical and problem-solving skills to identify new opportunities to grow Agoda’s business    Train and inform clients of both new and existing technologies, tools, and models  Prepare materials to aid in growing our business during partner meetings  Respond to partners requests in a timely and effective manner  Gain buy-in from relevant stakeholders to execute strategies and help launch prom

title: Key Account Manager - Divisione Sanità
description: Profilo ricercato:  Ricerchiamo una nuova figura per il ruolo di Key Account che si unirà al team Sales. Il profilo selezionato si specializzerà sul mercato Centro Sud Italia per la nostra suite di prodotti dedicata al settore sanitario, con particolare focus sull'ambito Casa di Cura. A stretto contatto con il Sales Manager, il nuovo profilo avrà l'opportunità di gestire e fidelizzare il portfolio di clienti esistenti, definire strategie di vendita ed individuare nuove opportunità tramite strategie di upselling e cross-selling  Il profilo ideale ha maturato almeno 2/3 anni di esperienza nella vendita di soluzioni software, preferibilmente nel settore Healthcare, e risiede nella provincia di Roma o zone limitrofe.  Skill tecniche:    Capacità di effettuare analisi di mercato  Conoscenze delle metodologie di analisi delle opportunità di vendita  Precisione nella gestione dei contratti con i clienti già acquisiti  Orientamento agli obbiettivi di vendita    Soft Skill:    Capacità di ascolto e comunicazione chiara, incisiva e precisa  Spiccate capacità relazionali  Attitudine proattiva con approccio "risk thinking"    Cosa Offriamo:     Smart Working   Flessibilità oraria   Academy interna e possibilità di crescita professionale    La retribuzione iniziale fa riferimento al livello d'inquadramento previsto per la posizione nel CCNL Commercio, con eventuali adeguamenti legati alla seniority emersa in fase di selezione  Essere parte di Onit vuol dire abbracciare valori come onestà, rispetto, equità, trasparenza, fiducia e responsabilità. Questi pilastri sono alla base delle nostre relazioni interne, creando un ambiente in cui ognuno può esercitare la propria attività in modo responsabile e flessibile. Accogliamo con entusiasmo candidati di ogni identità, convinti che la diversità sia la nostra più grande forza.  Se ti riconosci nei nostri valori, candidati ora. Ti contatteremo per un primo colloquio conoscitivo o conserveremo il tuo CV per opportunità future.  Dedichiamo tempo e cura alla valorizzazione del tuo talento, investiamo nelle tue competenze e diamo spazio alla tua voglia di metterti alla prova e fare la differenza. Se vuoi crescere insieme a ONIT verso l'obiettivo di essere il miglior partner nell'innovazione digitale, entra a far parte del nostro team!  La certificazione  Great Place to Work  conferma il nostro impegno per un ambiente lavorativo in cui il benessere e lo sviluppo delle persone sono la priorità, tanto quanto la soddisfazione dei clienti.   La registrazione sul nostro gestionale potrà esser fatta da te direttamente attraverso il pulsante "candidati" o dall'Ufficio People di Onit.   Ci teniamo a precisare che l'indice di compatibilità restituito dai test presenti in piattaforma è solo un riferimento per la valutazione; incoraggiamo tutte le persone a candidarsi alle nostre offerte di lavoro.

title: Palvelupäällikkö valtakunnalliseen asiakkuuteen Vantaalle
description: RTK-Palvelu Oy on suomalainen kiinteistöpalvelujen monialayhtiö jo 50 vuoden kokemuksella. Yhtiön 3000 ammattilaista antaa asiakkailleen päivittäin mahdollisuuden keskittyä olennaiseen. Olemme aidosti ylpeitä liiketoimintamme jalommasta tarkoituksesta, jonka myötä olemme omistajamme kautta jo vuosikymmenten ajan tukeneet lasten ja nuorten urheilua ja hyvinvointia valtakunnallisesti.   Tehtävänkuva ja odotukset Haemme valtakunnalliseen asiakkuuteen palvelupäällikköä, joka osallistuu niin asiakkuuden ohjausryhmätyöskentelyyn kuin kentän operatiiviseen toimintaan. Tuet nimetyn siivousasiakkuuden palvelutuotantoa, esihenkilöitä ja henkilöstöä eri puolilla Suomea sekä huolehdit siitä, että sovitut toimintatavat toteutuvat yhdenmukaisesti. Toimipisteesi sijaitsee pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta tarvitset tehtävässä B-luokan ajokorttia, sillä työ edellyttää säännöllistä matkustamista eri paikkakunnille.Sinulla on vahvat yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot sekä kyky rakentaa pitkäjänteisiä asiakassuhteita. Toimit luontevasti asiakkaan, oman organisaation ja eri yksiköiden kanssa ja viet sovitut asiat käytäntöön. Tehtävä edellyttää sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.Tehtävässä tarvitset kokemusta tiimien johtamisesta, henkilöstön innostamisesta ja yhteistyöstä yli organisaatiorajojen. Osaat johtaa toimintaa tavoitteellisesti sekä tukea esihenkilöitä ja henkilöstöä muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Arvostamme pitkää esihenkilökokemusta siivousalalta ja siivousalan erikoisammattitutkintoa.Tunnet siivouksen operatiivisen toiminnan, asiakkuuksien hoidon ja palvelusopimusten vaatimukset. Hallitset työssä tarvittavat järjestelmät ja hyödynnät tietoa toiminnan seurannassa, raportoinnissa, päätöksenteossa ja kehittämisessä. Varmistat palvelun laadun, sovittujen tavoitteiden toteutumisen ja arjen sujuvuuden yli yksikkörajojen. Tarvittaessa osallistut myös käytännön työhön kentällä.Kehität omaa työtäsi, palvelutuotantoa ja asiakkuutta pitkäjänteisesti yhdessä asiakkaan ja organisaation eri toimijoiden kanssa. Etsit käytännön ratkaisuja, joilla parannetaan laatua, tehokkuutta ja asiakaskokemusta. Työsi tueksi saat koko yrityksen tuen, ja työtä tehdään oikeasti yhdessä yli yksikkörajojen.   Tarjoamme Pääset osaksi motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen panosta. Yhteisömme ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava, mikä luo parhaat mahdolliset edellytykset onnistumiseesi.Pidämme huolta henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämisestä sekä työhyvinvoinnista. Pyrimme siihen, että työntekijämme työskentelevät meillä tyytyväisinä ja pitkään.Panostamme työturvallisuuteen vahvasti – tarjoamme esimerkiksi työturvallisuuskorttikoulutuksia sitä tarvitseville, ja kehitämme turvallisia työskentelytapoja jatkuvasti.Tarjoamme monipuolisia henkilöstöetuja, jotka tukevat hyvinvointiasi sekä arkeasi – etuihimme kuuluu lounasedun lisäksi muun muassa matkailuun, hyvinvointiin ja autoiluun liittyviä etuja. Virike-edulla haluamme kannustaa sinua liikkumaan ja palautumaan

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Are you driven, results-oriented and a team player?   With 17,000+ retailers and restaurants in over 15 countries, StoreHub is on a mission to enable everyone, big or small, to build successful businesses.     At StoreHub, we're building a dream team whereby all of your colleagues are extraordinary at what they do and are highly effective collaborators.     It is in such a team that you learn the most, perform your best work, improve the fastest, and have the most fun.      If this is a journey you’d like to embark on, keep reading!      The  Customer Success Manager (CSM)  is a commercial leader responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of live merchant accounts. This includes executing contract renewals, driving account expansion (upsells, add-ons), and building long-term customer partnerships. CSMs are trusted merchant advisors and revenue owners, ensuring that merchants achieve their goals while maximizing financial outcomes for StoreHub.     You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Onboarding, Product, and Support to resolve key merchant issues, identify opportunities, and close high-impact commercial decisions.      Responsibilities:    Own the commercial success of your assigned portfolio of merchants — including pitching and closing renewals, expansions, and add-ons.  Develop and execute win/win negotiation strategies that maximize contract value while protecting and enhancing customer trust.  Partner with the Sales and Onboarding team to fully understand and develop a clear renewal strategy for each customer.  Confidently lead commercial conversations with merchant decision-makers, including pricing, feature packaging, and contractual terms.  Maximize account growth opportunities by playing a collaborative role in the account team and helping to drive incremental revenue.  Identify customer requirements, uncover roadblocks, and proactively drive on-time renewal closures.  Collaborate with internal resources such as Finance, Product, Marketing, and Business Intelligence teams to develop comprehensive win strategies.  Provide executive visibility into renewals and solicit leadership involvement where needed to close high-risk or high-value deals.  Maintain accurate forecasts and CRM hygiene across all renewal and expansion opportunities. title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
About pplwise

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Supply Chain Manager (m/f/d) at Filics, you will build the supply chain that takes the robots into series production.

About the role

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.
Filics robots are built from hundreds of components. Many come from a single source, and most aren’t under contract yet. Moving from prototypes to series production, one missing part can stop the whole line. Your job is to build a robust supply chain from scratch. It needs to know exactly what Filics depends on, secure those parts before they become a risk, and hold up as volumes grow, all while production is already running. You take full ownership of how every component is sourced, secured and managed.
You’ll work closely with Engineering, which owns the technical specs and qualifies suppliers and alternative components. Assembly depends on reliable supply to plan builds. Leadership sets volume commitments

title: Pricing & Deal Desk Manager (m/f/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring a Pricing & Deal Desk Manager within the Revenue Operations team. You'd take ownership of one of Moss's highest-leverage commercial functions: the pricing deal desk. It's already delivered real results, and it matters more every quarter as deal volume grows and Moss moves into bigger, more complex deals.

What makes the role unusual is that the desk already runs on AI. An agent picks up each request, pulls the deal's scoring and call history, calculates margin, and drafts a reasoned reply; you approve, correct, or overrule it. So the job is two things at once: the reviewer who decides live deals, and the person who builds & improves the AI-based deal desk agent

Your responsibilities

  • Own the day-to-day approval flow for non-standard pricing, discounts, and commercial terms, acting as the fast, consistent escalation point for reps without slowing deals down.

  • Build and evolve pricing governance, including discount rules, approval thresholds, and playbooks, converting recurring exceptions into documented policy.

  • Drive deal health across the funnel: discount discipline, price realization, deal structure, and win rate by segment, diagnosing where deals leak value and fixing it.

Let’s fix hospitality, for good.

Hospitality is tough – margins are thin, waste is high, and teams are stretched. But it doesn’t have to be this hard. That’s why we built Nory.

Our CEO, Conor, knows the pain first-hand. After founding and scaling Mad Egg in Ireland, he got fed up with juggling “market-leading” systems, clunky spreadsheets, and endless printouts. So he set out to build the tool he wished he’d had from day one.

Nory is an all-knowing restaurant management system. It blends real-time data with AI predictive analytics, giving operators control of their margins. description:

You will:

title: Senior iOS Engineer (KMP) - POS
description:
Team description

The Order Taking squad owns core ordering experiences within SumUp's Point of Sale app, including the shopping bag, checkout, the catalog experience within ordering, open orders, table management and printer integrations. These capabilities help thousands of hospitality merchants manage orders reliably during daily service.

As a Senior iOS Engineer, you'll build new hospitality workflows and evolve established ordering experiences across iOS and Android. You'll work with SwiftUI on the platform-specific UI and contribute to shared Kotlin Multiplatform business logic. The role involves complex mobile engineering across multi-device synchronisation, shared order state and a large, established application.

You'll join a small, experienced and fast-moving squad that works collaboratively through technical refinement, code reviews and pair programming. The team values engineers who communicate directly, challenge assumptions and proactively shape solutions rather than simply execute predefined tasks.

What you'll do

  • Design and build new ordering experiences in SwiftUI, while evolving established capabilities such as table management, kitchen workflows and printer integrations
  • Contribute to shared Kotlin Multiplatform business logic and help shape the architecture of the ordering domain
  • Improve the reliability and usability of ordering features used daily by hospitality merchants across phones, tablets and POS devices
  • Collaborate closely with Android engineers and platform teams to maintain consistent cross-platform behaviour and reliable multi-device order synchronisation
  • Take part in code reviews, pair programming and collaborative testing to maintain a high quality bar
  • Help refine and scope upcoming work, bringing technical judgement to product and architectural trade-offs
  • Contribute to Mobile Chapter and KMP platform i

title: Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing - alternance
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Lorsque l'on vous dit Deliveroo, vous imaginez sans doute d'abord les bons petits plats livrés chez vous en moins d'une demi-heure. Plutôt sympa non ? Mais c'est en coulisses que l'histoire est la plus intéressante. Nous opérons désormais à travers le monde et travaillons avec plus de 176 000 restaurants partenaires et commerces en tous genres en France. Nous collaborons avec des milliers de livreurs et de livreuses partenaires pour le plus grand bonheur de nos millions de personnes clientes.

Nous recherchons un·e Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing Merchant en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à Paris, pour une durée de 12 mois. Aux côtés de l'équipe Merchant, vous contribuerez au développement de la croissance de nos partenaires, au déploiement de nos campagnes nationales 360° et en accompagnerez des projets à fort impact sur l'acquisition, la rétention et la fidélisation de nos restaurants partenaires.

Descriptif du poste :

En tant qu'Apprenti(e) dans l'équipe Marketing Merchant Restaurant, vous travaillerez au quotidien avec l'équipe marketing chargée de mettre en avant toute la sélection de restaurants et de partenaires de Deliveroo. Vous serez également amené(e) à interagir régulièrement avec les autres départements marketing tels que l'équipe média, l'équipe créative, le CRM ainsi qu'avec l'équipe commerciale. 

Vos missions consisteront à:

  • Mettre en avant sur l'application les restaurants et partenaires disponibles sur l'app.</

Ninox ist eine Berliner Low-Code-Plattform, mit der Teams genau die Geschäftsanwendungen bauen, die sie brauchen. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende, tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa, vom kleinen Team bis zum Großunternehmen. Ein Produkt, an dem Menschen wirklich hängen. Wir sind seit 12 Jahren am Markt, etabliert, wachsen und sind solide mit Wagniskapital finanziert.

Worum es geht

Du machst Outbound. Zu 100 %, und vor allem am Telefon.

Du bekommst Zielaccounts aus Branchen, die wir vorab festlegen, findest dort die Menschen, die das Problem tatsächlich haben, rufst sie an — und buchst qualifizierte Erstgespräche für unsere Account Executives. Nach dem Handover übernimmt der AE. Dein Ergebnis ist das stattgefundene, qualifizierte Gespräch, nicht der Abschluss und nicht der Kalendereintrag.

Der größte Teil unseres Geschäfts sind kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, dazu kommt ein solider Anteil Mid-Market. Innerhalb der Verticals, die für uns nachweislich funktionieren, gehen wir gelegentlich auch in größere Organisationen. Damit es keine Missverständnisse gibt: „Enterprise" heißt bei uns Unternehmen mit einigen hundert bis wenigen tausend Mitarbeitenden — nicht DAX-Konzern mit zweijährigem Beschaffungsprozess und Rahmenvertragsverhandlung.

Du arbeitest auf Deutsch und auf Englisch, jeden Tag. Deutschland und Großbritannien sind unsere Kernmärkte, weitere europäische Länder kommen situativ dazu.

Dein Umfeld, ehrlich beschrieben: Unser Vertrieb arbeitet heute Full-Funnel. Die Account Executives machen neben allem anderen rund eine Stunde Outbound pro Tag. Dazu kommt eine Kollegin bzw. ein Kollege mit ebenfalls reinem Outbound-Fokus, allerdings auf Kooperationen, Webinare und Partner. Du bist damit die erste Person bei uns, die ausschließlich und direkt auf Neukunden-Erstgespräche geht. title: Deployment Lead - ERP Solutions
description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve

title: Research Engineer, Latency & Throughput
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Research Engineer on the Latency & Throughput team, you will push the frontier of LLM inference by researching and prototyping techniques that reduce latency and increase throughput — from speculative decoding and quantization to KV compression and new attention variants. The team sits at the intersection of research and production: you will take ideas from recent literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and ship the techniques that prove out into our serving stack.

This role sits between our inference engineers, who own the production serving stack, and our research scientists, who focus on paper-level contributions. You will be more science-focused than a pure engineer: you are expected to generate new ideas, keep up with the state of the art, and implement proof-of-concepts that bridge the gap between academic results and production impact. Some techniques you explore will be lossy or require integration into training — retraining models, tuning architectures, or training auxiliary models to improve inference.

title: Customer Information Development Manager
description: Closing Date for Applications    4th November 2026  Salary scale: £52,000 - £62,000 per annum.   What is the purpose of this job?   The Customer Information Development Manager is responsible for leading and driving improvements in rail customer information through industry collaboration, customer insight, proposition development and enhancement of national customer information systems. The role brings together stakeholders across train operators, Network Rail, government and industry bodies to identify priorities, deliver improvements and ensure customer needs are reflected in industry decision-making.  With Great British Railways (GBR) on the horizon, this is a unique opportunity to lead and deliver industry-wide initiatives that will help shape and support the future vision of GBR. Customer Information is central to delivering an enhanced customer experience and remains a key area of industry focus, innovation and investment. The role will lead projects that improve how information is provided to customers across the rail industry, including the development of new customer information products and services, the creation of industry policy and standards, and the enhancement of existing information channels to deliver better outcomes for passengers.  The role is responsible for managing and coordinating two key rail industry SME groups: the Customer Information Group (CIG) and the Redress and Support Group. CIG brings together customer information experts from TOCs, Network Rail and RDG to drive improvements through best-practice sharing and the delivery of quick-win initiatives. The Redress and Support Group focuses on improving customer contact, complaints handling, compensation processes and governance of the Rail ADR Scheme, bringing together customer relations leaders and SMEs from across the industry.  The role leads the industry's Brilliant Basics workstream, driving improvements in customer information through low-cost, operational enhancements, while overseeing central reporting delivered by the National Rail Communications Centre.  To ensure we put the customer at the heart of what we do at RDG, customer research and insight is critical. The role will own the InfoTracker survey; an industry survey measuring customer satisfaction with customer information, working closely with the Research and Insights team to deliver actionable insights to stakeholders. The role will also work with the Data Analysis team to make data available for stakeholders and developing reports in Tableau.  The role will also play a pivotal part in helping the Customer team within RDG to deliver its objectives, supporting members of the customer team and others within the RDG organisation. title: Customer Success Manager - Banking Loyalty
description: About The Role   We are looking for a commercial, operationally sharp Customer Success Manager to own a portfolio of banking loyalty clients across South Asia and the Maldives, running on Loyalife, our loyalty SaaS platform. You will carry revenue and retention targets while keeping day-to-day operations tight: accrual and redemption health, order and voucher delivery, tickets and escalations. Banks should see you as the single owner who grows the program and fixes problems before they surface.   What You’ll Do     Own commercial growth. Deliver against revenue and retention targets across the portfolio. Drive renewals, and identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities such as new modules, campaigns, catalog categories and enhancements.  Drive accrual and redemption. Track accrual, redemption trends and catalog performance for every bank. Work with Supply and Growth teams to sharpen offers, merchants and categories (vouchers, travel, experiences, merchandise, top-ups) for local consumer preferences.  Run BAU with discipline. Own the daily rhythm for every client: tickets, delivery failures, catalog quality, SLAs and closure with Product, Tech and Support. No client should have to chase us for an update.  Lead executive relationships. Run QBRs and MBRs, build success plans, and work directly with bank heads of cards, loyalty, digital and marketing to tie program performance to business outcomes.  Protect account health. Keep health scores and CRM hygiene current, flag risks early, own escalation plans, and partner with Finance on billing and receivables follow-up.  Be the voice of the client. Convert client needs into clear requirements and Jira tickets, and influence the product roadmap with structured feedback.     What We’re Looking For     Banking loyalty experience. Hands-on work with bank or card loyalty programs: earn rules, tiers, points liability, redemption catalogs, campaigns and partner merchants. This is the core requirement.  SaaS experience. 4 to 7 years in customer success or account management at a B2B SaaS or platform company, with a record of managing enterprise accounts against revenue and retention targets.  Commercial instinct. Proven ability to find expansion within existing accounts, negotiate commercial terms and present ROI to senior bank stakeholders.  Operational grip. Comfortable running several clients at once, working tickets and escalations to closure, and coordinating Product, Tech, Supply and Support teams.  Bank stakeholder skills. Experience with bank governance, procurement, change control and UAT cycles. Familiarity with South Asian banking markets is a strong plus.  Communication. Clear, confident written and spoken English, at ease with C-level and senior bank audiences.  Tools. Working knowledge of Jira and a CRM (HubSpot preferred), and strong Excel skills for redemption, revenue and account analysis.  Location. Based in Bangalore, working from the Xoxoday HQ office. What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve

title: Senior RAMS Engineer
description:
We are looking for a RAMS Engineer to strengthen our safety and compliance team, with a particular emphasis on safety engineering for our vehicles, propulsion systems, ground infrastructure, and operations.

RAMS covers Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety. This role will apply those principles across the full lifecycle of complex hardware and operational systems, helping ensure that hazards are identified early, risks are controlled, and safety requirements are supported by clear technical evidence.

Although the role sits within safety and compliance rather than systems engineering, you will need a strong systems-engineering background and experience working with high-reliability, high-safety, or mission-critical systems.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

About ALPAMI

At ALPAMI we're building a boutique hospitality brand. ALPAMI operates 200+ keys across the Black Forest, Switzerland, Tirol, and Munich — spanning City Boutique Houses, Tiny Houses in Nature, and Properties as a Service. We're not chasing stars; we're chasing 5-star experiences delivered in our own, unmistakably boutique way.

We're bootstrapped, founder-led, and growing fast — with a clear target of 500 units next year. That means the operational engine behind our guest experience needs to scale just as fast, and that's exactly where you come in.

We're looking for an Operations Manager who reports directly to the MD and, from our Munich HQ, keeps the operational engine behind our guest experience running: you make sure our Customer Care team always has the relevant information at hand, support them in guest communication, and steer our local stakeholders on site. This is not a job for someone who wants a quiet 9-to-5. description: Customer Service Manager Logistiek      De Customer Service-afdeling van VTS staat voor een volgende stap. We groeien hard en professionaliseren tegelijkertijd. Korte lijnen, ondernemerschap en volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief in een toonaangevend familiebedrijf.        Wie ben jij?    Ruime ervaring in een leidinggevende functie in de customer service binnen de logistieke sector.   Leiderschap waarmee je mensen weet mee te nemen én aan te spreken. Werken bij VTS   Bij VTS geloven we dat succes wordt gebouwd door mensen die verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Mensen met vakmanschap, een ondernemende mindset en een nuchtere blik op de praktijk. Daarnaast is er ondersteuning beschikbaar vanuit een externe specialist op het gebied van data en klantretentie. Jij bepaalt waar AI het werk overneemt en waar een persoonlijk gesprek beter werkt.     Je eerste uitdaging: meedenken over de keuze tussen HubSpot en Intercom en de workflows daarna zelf bouwen. title: Senior implementation manager
description: Senior launch manager   Hybrid role based in our Dublin office, with occasional travel to our UK offices as needed   About Us   Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.  We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.  We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.  We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.  We’re now expanding into Europe, starting in Ireland. As we build Seccl Ireland, we’re looking for a senior launch manager to play a key role in turning new customer opportunities into successful launches.  Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.  The role  As senior launch manager, you’ll own the journey from the early stages of a customer conversation through to onboarding, implementation and migration.  You’ll work with fintechs, advice firms, adviser aggregators and larger enterprise businesses, getting under the skin of what they’re trying to build and helping them work out how Seccl can make it happen.  This is a hands-on, customer-facing role. You’ll lead workshops, get into the detail of technical integrations, help firms navigate our APIs and operational processes, and keep complex launches moving at pace.  You’ll also have plenty of opportunity to shape how we do things. As we build our presence in Ireland, you’ll help identify product and technical gaps, improve our onboarding approach and make each launch better than the last.  You’ll be part of our launch team, reporting to our head of strategic delivery. description: Location: Anywhere in Country  At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. Op de korte termijn vraagt de baan vooral de rol van Technisch Projectmanager, maar in de nabije toekomst varieer je in je rollen als Business Consultant / Analist, Product Owner, samenvattend; Manager IT Operations met ondersteuning van externe software developers  Een bijdrage leveren in het plezier binnen het (sport)verenigingsleven. description:

    Who we are   
  Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.  
  Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.     About the role:  
 This is a high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to small to medium size customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $5k to $20k, and typically involve proof of concepts, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to owners, safety and operational managers. 
   This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.   
  You should apply if:   
 
  You want to impact the industries that run our world:  Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. 
  Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting:  The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

  You build genuine relationships with your customers:  The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. 
  You want to be with the best:  Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
