title: Head of Customer Experience
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Customer Experience based in Sweden.   Join a fast-growing wellness business transforming how people connect, recharge, and experience well-being through memorable, community-driven activities. As Head of Customer Experience, you will lead the strategy for customer satisfaction, retention, loyalty, memberships, and repeat revenue across multiple locations. You will manage and develop a customer-facing team while building scalable processes that turn first-time visitors into loyal, long-term customers. Combining customer-centric leadership with commercial thinking and data-driven decision-making, you will identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and drive sustainable growth. Working cross-functionally with Marketing and Operations, you will develop personalized engagement strategies, strengthen membership performance, and optimize service delivery. This remote opportunity offers flexible working arrangements, professional growth, and the chance to help shape the customer experience of an ambitious, expanding wellness brand.  Accountabilities    Customer experience and team leadership: Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Customer Experience team, setting clear expectations and fostering a culture of accountability, empathy, and continuous improvement.   Customer service excellence: Own service performance metrics, including response times, resolution rates, customer satisfaction, and service recovery. Establish consistent service standards and training programs across locations.   Scalable systems and processes: Develop efficient workflows, standard operating procedures, and a centralized knowledge base to support consistent customer service as the business expands.   Customer support channels: Improve accessibility and responsiveness across communication channels, including email, phone, live chat, and text messaging.   Technology and automation: Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through customer service technology, automation, and AI while preserving a personal, customer-focused approach.   Customer journey optimization: Own the customer feedback ecosystem, including surveys, reviews, satisfaction tracking, and online reputation management. Analyze feedback and customer behavior to identify friction points and improvement opportunities.   Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Studio Operations to improve the end-to-end guest experience and collaborate with Marketing to develop effective retention campaigns, personalized offers, and lifecycle communications.   Customer retention and loyalty: Develop and execute strategies that increase repeat bookings, purchase frequency, customer lifetime value, and revenue from existing customers.   Membership and class-pack growth: Oversee membership and class-pack performance, including conversion, onboarding, engagemen

title: Bilingual Senior Customer Experience Manager
description: Senior Customer Experience Manager  ポジション概要  Ten Groupでは、世界中の会員に対して、オンライン・オフラインを問わず、シームレスで質の高い顧客体験を提供するため、グローバルCXチームを構築しています。  本ポジションは、特定のクライアントを担当し、顧客体験の向上に向けた課題の特定から改善施策の企画・実行までを推進する役割です。  Senior CX Team Managerにレポートし、日本を含む各地域のオペレーションチームとグローバルチーム、関連部門をつなぐ重要な役割を担います。顧客の利用体験全体を理解し、データ分析や顧客フィードバックをもとにサービス品質、業務効率、顧客満足度の向上を目指します。  また、グローバルのCX戦略や改善方針に沿って、各部門と連携しながら、顧客視点を重視する文化の醸成と継続的なサービス改善を推進していただきます。  主な業務内容  1. 顧客体験の分析・改善     顧客の利用体験（カスタマージャーニー）全体を分析し、課題や改善機会を特定する  オンボーディングから継続利用、問題解決、顧客ロイヤルティの向上まで、顧客ライフサイクル全体の体験を改善する  すべての問い合わせチャネルにおけるサービスジャーニーを見直し、利便性と一貫性を向上させる  顧客ニーズ、行動、期待、課題を把握するための調査・分析を実施する  ミステリーショッピング、競合分析、市場動向の調査などを通じて、新たな改善機会を発見する   2. データ分析・KPI管理     顧客の声やサービスデータを収集・分析し、データに基づく意思決定を支援する  CSAT（顧客満足度）、NPS（顧客推奨度）、CES（顧客努力指標）、CLV（顧客生涯価値）などの指標を活用し、顧客体験を測定する  顧客体験に関する主要KPIを設定・モニタリングし、分析結果や改善提案をレポートする  顧客の課題や既存の改善要望を整理し、根本原因の分析と優先順位付けを行う   3. 改善プロジェクトの企画・推進     CX改善ロードマップおよび実行計画を策定し、施策の進捗と成果を管理する  グローバルCXチーム、地域マネージャー、オペレーション、プロダクトなどの関係部門と連携し、改善施策を推進する  プロダクト開発、サービス企画、顧客向けコミュニケーション、トレーニングなど、関連プロジェクトとの整合性を確保する  複数のプロジェクト間の依存関係や必要なリソースを把握し、効果的な実行を支援する  Quality Analystによる品質評価・キャリブレーションのフィードバックをもとに、毎月の改善計画とマイルストーンを策定・実行する   4. 顧客フィードバック・サービス品質の向上     顧客の意見や懸念を収集・分析する仕組みを整備し、改善につなげる  Lifestyle Managerからのフィードバックも収集し、現場の課題や改善ニーズを把握する  Lifestyle Managerに対して、優れた顧客サービスを提供するための教育・トレーニングを実施する  エスカレーションされた顧客の問題やクレームについて、迅速かつ効果的な解決を推進する  顧客満足度、顧客ロイヤルティ、サービス品質の継続的な向上を目指す   5. グローバル連携・CX文化の醸成     グローバルCXチームや各地域の関係者と協働し、ベストプラクティスを共有する  顧客視点を組織全体に浸透させ、顧客体験を重視する文化の醸成を推進する  CXに関する業界動向や最新の手法、テクノロジーを把握し、改善施策に取り入れる  従来のやり方にとらわれず、新しい発想やアプローチを通じて、将来を見据えた顧客体験の向上を実現する     Requirements    応募資格・必須要件   英語およびビジネスレベルの日本語で、社内外の関係者と円滑にコミュニケーションできる方  顧客のニーズ、行動、期待を理解し、顧客視点で物事を考えられる方  データや顧客フィードバックを分析し、課題の特定と改善提案ができる方  顧客満足度やサービス品質の向上に向けて、主体的に課題解決に取り組める方  複数の部門や関係者と連携し、プロジェクトを推進できる方  顧客の感情や懸念を理解し、共感を持って対応できる方  顧客ニーズや事業上の優先順位の変化に柔軟に対応できる方  CSAT、NPS、CES、CLVなどの顧客満足度・ロイヤルティ指標に関する知識、または学習意欲がある方  新しいテクノロジーやデジタルツールを積極的に活用できる方   歓迎する経験・スキル   顧客体験（CX）、顧客満足度向上、カスタマーサポート、カスタマーサクセス、サービスオペレーション、品質管理（QA）などの関連業務経験  顧客中心のサービスを重視する企業での勤務経験（6年以上の経験があれば尚可）  複数の部門やさまざまな役職の関係者と協働し、業務改善や組織変革を推進した経験  顧客データの分析、KPI管理、レポート作成の経験  Microsoft Excel、PowerPointなどの実務経験  Lean Six Sigmaなどの業務改善手法に関する知識・実践経験  AIツールやデジタルソリューションの活用経験   求める人物像   好奇心が旺盛で、データや事実に基づいて論理的に考えられる方  日々の業務において、常に顧客視点を大切にできる方  新しいツールや手法を積極的に学び、改善に活かせる方  スピード感と高い目標が求められる環境でも、主体的に行動できる方  プロジェクトの計画から実行、成果の検証まで責任を持って取り組める方  業務プロセスや細部にも注意を払い、計画的に仕事を進められる方  自律的に業務を進めながら、チームで協力して成果を出せる方  部門や役職を越えた関係者との協働を楽しめる方  現状にとらわれず、新しいアイデアを通じて顧客体験をより良くしたいという意欲がある方   このポジションの魅力   グローバルチームの一員として、世界各地の関係者と協働できる  顧客体験の分析から改善施策の企画・実行まで、一貫して携われる  データや顧客の声をもとに、サービス品質や業務プロセスの改善を推進できる  複数部門と連携しながら、顧客満足度と顧客ロイヤルティの向上に貢献できる  新しいアイデアや改善手法を取り入れ、将来の顧客体験づくりに携われる     Benefits    働き方：月曜から金曜勤務（土日祝お休み）  勤務時間：9-18時/10-19時/11-20時  在宅勤務：試用期間6か月後は、週2-3日程度在宅可能

title: 《大阪：守口》デジタル/AIを活用したお客様接点強化の取り組みの戦略立案【PC CSセンター】
description: 職務内容    AVC CS企画部のミッション    ブランドを高める／ブランドを守る・支える取り組みについてAVCCSやCSセンターをリードし、パナソニックブランド高揚に貢献    戦略企画課のミッション    Customer Focusでより良い未来を描き、実現に向けて挑戦！パナソニックブランドを高める／守る・支える活動を実行・リード！    募集背景    AIを中心としたデジタル技術の目まぐるしい進化に伴い、お客様のお困りごとをサポートするCS業務も大きな変革を迫られています。ChatGPTやCopilotなどAIツールの活用は日常生活でも当たり前になりつつある中、ボイスボットやAIチャットボットによるお客様サポートの拡充やAIに選ばれるWebコンテンツ整備など、世の中のトレンドを敏感に察知しながらスピード感を持った施策の立案と実行が求められています。お客様の感性価値・体験価値向上によりブランド力を強化していくという経営方針を成し遂げるために、CS活動は大きな役割を担っています。他社に負けない圧倒的なお客様サポート体験の実現に向け、デジタル/AIを活用したお客様接点強化の取り組みを力強く推進できる人財を募集します。    担当業務と役割    ・主な担当業務は、AVC管轄製品に関するデジタル/AIを活用した「お客様サポートの戦略立案」「ツール導入企画と実行計画の立案」「他部署と連携したお客様サポート変革プロジェクトのマネジメント」になります。（主な管轄製品：テレビ/レコーダー/カメラ/ヘッドホン/ドアホン/電話・FAX/ホームネットワークなど）  ・製品に関するお困りごとが発生したお客様に対して、いかにストレスフリーなサポートを提供するかを考える「企画力」、それを実行する「プロジェクトマネジメント力」、他部署の様々なメンバーと連携しながら協調関係を築く「コミュニケーション力」を持って、新たなお客様サポート施策を考え実行いただきます。  ・製品の購入、使用中、買替にいたる全てのカスタマージャーニーにおいて、デジタル/AIを活用しお客様と繋がり続ける活動を強化することが、この仕事の大切な役割です。    具体的な仕事内容    ・お客様対応におけるAI活用の戦略立案と実行：年間40万件を超える相談センターへの問い合わせを中心に、営業時間外でも24時間365日お客様に自己解決いただけるようなボイスボット/チャットボットの導入展開と改善PDCAサイクルの実行し、お客様自己解決の促進によるお客様体験価値向上と有人対応抑制による経営貢献を実現。  ・VOC分析と商品/サービスへの活用戦略検討：AIを中心とした関連ツールの導入展開と改善PDCA活動の取りまとめ、VOCを全社で活用するための運用スキーム検討と現場への落とし込みにより、お客様の声を反映した商品/サービス作りに貢献。 description: Brænder du for ledelse, IT-drift og en hverdag tæt på Forsvarets operative virkelighed? Har du lyst til at stå i spidsen for et lokalt IT-servicecenter, hvor god service, sikker drift og stærke relationer går hånd i hånd? Så er stillingen som leder for Lokal IT Servicecenter på Aalborg Flyvestation måske dit næste skridt.   Om os   Lokal IT Servicecenter Aalborg Flyvestation er en del af de regionale servicecentre, der dækker Midt- og Nordjylland. Servicecenteret løser lokale IT-opgaver for Forsvarets brugere på Aalborg flyvestation og i områdets øvrige lokaliteter, og arbejder tæt sammen med de øvrige Lokale IT Servicecentre i regionen.  Vi er en del af Cyberdivisionen ved Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse. Opgaverne spænder bredt og omfatter blandt andet brugersupport, drift af administrative netværk, IT-systemer, AV-udstyr, mobiltelefoner og udlån af IT-materiel.  Vores arbejdsdag er præget af tillid, fleksibilitet og frihed under ansvar. Vi lægger vægt på ordentlighed, tydelig kommunikation og en uformel tone, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og tager fælles ansvar for både opgaveløsning og trivsel. Hos os er stabil drift ikke bare teknik. Det er fundamentet for, at de operative enheder kan løse deres opgaver.   Om stillingen   Som leder for Lokal IT Servicecenter på Aalborg Flyvestation, får du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse, drift og udvikling af servicecenteret. Du bliver omdrejningspunktet for et team, der leverer lokal IT-support til kunder og brugere, hvor kravene til service, sikkerhed og driftsstabilitet er høje.  Du vil få ansvar for personaleledelse, prioritering af opgaver, koordinering med brugere og samarbejdspartnere, samt løbende udvikling af arbejdsgange og kvalitet i opgaveløsningen. Du skal kunne skabe overblik, sætte retning og sikre, at medarbejderne har rammerne til at lykkes i en travl hverdag.  Du indgår i regionens ledergruppe og bidrager aktivt til den tværgående udvikling af Lokal IT Service i Midt- og Nordjylland. Det betyder, at du både skal kunne lede lokalt og tænke regionalt. Du skal være med til at skabe ensartede procedurer, styrke videndeling og sikre, at vi bruger ressourcerne klogt på tværs af Lokale IT Servicecentre.   Dine Opgaver Vil Blandt Andet Være At     lede og udvikle medarbejderne i Lokal IT Servicecenter på Aalborg Flyvestation  sikre stabil drift, god service og rettidig opgaveløsning  prioritere og koordinere support i samarbejde med regionens øvrige Lokale IT Servicecentre  understøtte brugerne med IT i et operativt miljø, hvor sikkerhed og tilgængelighed er afgørende  bidrage til materielstyring, beholdningsansvar og administrative processer  omsætte fælles regionale beslutninger til konkrete lokale handlinger  medvirke til et stærkt arbejdsmiljø med trivsel, faglighed og ordentlighed som bærende elementer     Om dig   Vi søger først og fremmest en leder, der kan skabe følgeskab. Du behøver ikke være den dybeste tekniske specialist i rummet, men du skal forstå IT-driften

title: Onboarding Manager – tomedo.air (m/w/d)
description: Vorrede   tomedo.air ist unsere neue, plattformunabhängige Praxissoftware. Damit immer mehr Praxen erfolgreich starten können, ohne dass unser Onboarding-Aufwand im gleichen Maß wächst, brauchen wir klare Standards statt individueller Einzellösungen. Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel: Du nimmst dem Komplexen das Komplizierte und entwickelst einen skalierbaren Onboarding-Prozess.   Wo Du mit anpacken kannst     Du entwickelst unseren Onboarding-Prozess weiter und sorgst für einen klaren Weg von der Übergabe aus dem Vertrieb bis zum stabilen Praxisbetrieb. Dabei legst Du auch fest, wann eine Praxis wirklich startklar ist.  Statt bei jeder Umstellung das Rad neu zu erfinden, schaffst Du Standards und Abläufe, die für immer mehr Praxen funktionieren – mit möglichst wenig individuellem Aufwand.  Du machst andere fit: Mit Leitfäden, Einarbeitung und klaren Prozessen befähigst Du unsere Teams, Praxisumstellungen auch regional eigenständig durchzuführen.  Damit unser Onboarding mit tomedo.air wachsen kann, planst Du Rollouts vorausschauend. Reihenfolge, Termine, Kapazitäten und parallele Umstellungen hast Du dabei im Blick und erkennst Engpässe frühzeitig.  Theorie allein reicht Dir nicht: Anfangs begleitest Du selbst Praxen bei ihrer Umstellung, erkennst Stolpersteine aus erster Hand und machst unsere Abläufe Schritt für Schritt besser.  KI und digitale Tools sind für Dich willkommene Unterstützung. Du findest heraus, wie wir damit Prozesse vereinfachen und unsere Rollouts schneller und verlässlicher gestalten können.  Kurze Wege statt langer Abstimmungsschleifen: In unserem kleinen Team arbeitest Du eng mit Technik, Anwendungsberatung und Vertrieb zusammen und bringst alle Beteiligten auf einen gemeinsamen Kurs.  Du arbeitest von einem unserer Standorte oder aus dem Homeoffice und bist bereit, für Praxiseinführungen deutschlandweit unterwegs zu sein. Auch Teilzeit ist möglich, idealerweise ab 30 Stunden pro Woche.     Was Du mitbringen solltest     Du bringst Erfahrung im Prozessmanagement oder Projektmanagement mit und hast Lust, nicht nur einzelne Projekte zu steuern, sondern Strukturen zu schaffen, die langfristig funktionieren.  Wo andere komplizierte Abläufe sehen, erkennst Du den roten Faden. Du entwickelst daraus klare, skalierbare Prozesse und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick.  Wissen ist zum Teilen da! Du kannst andere für neue Abläufe gewinnen, verständliche Anleitungen entwickeln und Teams befähigen, eigenständig zu arbeiten.  Du übernimmst Verantwortung, denkst voraus und sorgst dafür, dass keine Praxis auf der Strecke bleibt oder auf ihren nächsten Schritt warten muss.  Ob Praxis, Technik, Anwendungsberatung oder Vertrieb: Du findest den richtigen Draht zu unterschiedlichen Menschen und bringst alle Beteiligten an einen Tisch.  Du hast Lust, KI und digitale Werkzeuge sinnvoll einzusetzen. Erfahrung mit Softwareeinführungen im Gesundheitswesen ist ein Plus, tiefes Technikwissen rund um Netzwerke, Server oder Ins

title: Manager Claims Service
description: At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.   Job Description   The Bilingual Manager of Claims Service is responsible for leading and developing frontline Claims Service teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience while ensuring consistent execution of claims processes and achievement of operational objectives. This leader oversees team performance, staffing and workload, using data and insights to identify opportunities to improve service, efficiency, quality, and the employee experience. The Manager leads operational and process changes, partners across Claims and the broader organization to remove barriers and improve workflows, and fosters an engaged, accountable, and inclusive team culture. Partners with Claims leaders, Workforce Management, Learning & Development, Human Resources, and other business partners to achieve operational objectives and resolve barriers.  Manages escalated customer, employee, and operational issues, ensuring appropriate ownership and resolution. Strong operational leadership skills with the ability to use data and business insights to drive decisions and improve performance.  Strong customer focus and demonstrated ability to lead teams through change.  Excellent communication, relationship-building, problem-solving, and influencing skills. title: Customer Success Representative

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager

title: Customer Success Coordinator
description: About youX   youX is the infrastructure behind modern asset finance. Our connected platform powers compliant, seamless finance journeys for OEMs, dealerships, brokers, aggregators and lenders across Australia —processing over 1.2 million applications and $7.4 billion in finance opportunities annually, with 80+ lenders on the network.     We're on a mission to make finance simpler, smarter and more connected, and we're looking for a Customer Success Coordinator to help deliver an outstanding experience to our customers.      The Role   You'll be a trusted point of contact for a portfolio of clients, ensuring everything runs smoothly behind the scenes. From coordinating requests and managing account administration to supporting onboarding and building strong relationships, you'll play a key role in helping our customers get real, measurable value from the youX platform.      What You'll Do   • Be the day-to-day contact for a portfolio of exisiting clients, from  onboarding through to renewal.  • Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders, becoming their go-to for all things youX.  • Coordinate customer requests and ensure they're resolved promptly, working closely with Product, Support and Development teams.  • Manage account administration, documentation and system updates, keeping accurate customer records.  • Support new customer onboarding and implementation activities.  • Monitor account health and activity, proactively identifying opportunities to improve the customer experience and flagging any risks to retention early.  • Help coordinate customer communications, training and product updates.  • Ensure customers receive a consistent, professional and friendly experience every time they interact with youX.      About You   You'll thrive in this role if you:  • Have experience in customer relations — whether that's customer service, customer success, account coordination or client relationship management.  • Enjoy building genuine relationships with people.  • Are highly organised and love keeping things on track, with great attention to detail.  • Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable engaging everyone from  dealership staff to CEOs.  • Are proactive, resourceful and enjoy solving problems.  • Work well independently and as part of a collaborative team — self-starter discipline suited to remote work.  • Are comfortable learning new systems and technology, including CRM platforms.      What would help your applicatation   • Experience in SaaS, fintech, banking, automotive or financial services.  • Experience in Broker, Dealer or OEM leading platforms.  • Experience using CRM platforms or customer success tooling.  • Knowledge of the Australian asset or automotive finance ecosystem.      Why youX   • Competitive salary package.  • A high-growth fintech shaping how Australia does asset finance.  • Small, sharp team where your work is visible and your voice counts.      How to Apply

title: Account Manager (Customer Operations)
description: About NVD   A family-owned business, established in 1980, NVD was set up to assist vehicle manufacturers in the timely and incident free distribution of their products. We’ve established ourselves as a one stop shop providing the three main pillars of outbound logistics, including transporting, storing and enhancing our customers’ vehicles, prior to delivery to their end location. Since 1980 NVD has been at the forefront of pioneering the digitisation of the FVL industry. As early adopters of emerging technology we have been able to introduce huge efficiencies saving time and money for our customers. Our unwavering commitment to progress and continual service improvement remains at the heart of our business today.   Summary Of Position   Due to rapid growth across our Ireland and UK Sites we are looking for an Account Manager who will report to the Customer Operations Manager, this role is responsible for the day-to-day operational management of key accounts.  The successful candidate will plan and execute account activities to the highest standards, collaborating with external stakeholders and internal teams to ensure we consistently meet and exceed agreed targets.  The role pivots on usage of a comprehensive ERP software system, in addition to a CRM system (Salesforce) and a supporting project management tool. An ability to lead work through these systems and supporting processes is a fundamental requirement for the role. title: Manager, Customer Success
description: About Dialpad   Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.  Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved.  Market-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile.   Being a Dialer   At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee’s hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.  We believe every conversation matters. And we’ve built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.  We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits:  Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic .   Your role    As the Manager, Customer Success at Dialpad, you will lead a team of Customer Success Managers (Key Accounts) dedicated to ensuring that our customers derive maximum value from our platform. You will be responsible for managing customer relationships, driving product adoption, and cultivating long-term partnerships that lead to customer retention and growth. You will be the voice of the customer internally and will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our solutions continue to meet and exceed customer expectations.  You will help develop strategies to engage with at-risk customers to improve outcomes. You will be responsible for reporting team statistics and performance results to other members of the leadership team and executive staff.  This position reports to our SVP, Customer Success and is hybrid based in our Kitchener, Ontario Office.   What You’ll Do     Lead and Develop the Team: Build, manage, and mentor a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs) who support Dialpad’s Key customers. Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and development to help your team deliver exceptional customer outcomes. title: Head of Customer Experience
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Customer Experience based in Australia.   Join a fast-growing wellness business transforming how people connect, recharge, and experience well-being through memorable, community-driven activities. As Head of Customer Experience, you will lead the strategy for customer satisfaction, retention, loyalty, memberships, and repeat revenue across multiple locations. You will manage and develop a customer-facing team while building scalable processes that turn first-time visitors into loyal, long-term customers. Combining customer-centric leadership with commercial thinking and data-driven decision-making, you will identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and drive sustainable growth. Working cross-functionally with Marketing and Operations, you will develop personalized engagement strategies, strengthen membership performance, and optimize service delivery. This remote opportunity offers flexible working arrangements, professional growth, and the chance to help shape the customer experience of an ambitious, expanding wellness brand.  Accountabilities    Customer experience and team leadership: Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Customer Experience team, setting clear expectations and fostering a culture of accountability, empathy, and continuous improvement.   Customer service excellence: Own service performance metrics, including response times, resolution rates, customer satisfaction, and service recovery. Establish consistent service standards and training programs across locations.   Scalable systems and processes: Develop efficient workflows, standard operating procedures, and a centralized knowledge base to support consistent customer service as the business expands.   Customer support channels: Improve accessibility and responsiveness across communication channels, including email, phone, live chat, and text messaging.   Technology and automation: Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through customer service technology, automation, and AI while preserving a personal, customer-focused approach.   Customer journey optimization: Own the customer feedback ecosystem, including surveys, reviews, satisfaction tracking, and online reputation management. Analyze feedback and customer behavior to identify friction points and improvement opportunities.   Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Studio Operations to improve the end-to-end guest experience and collaborate with Marketing to develop effective retention campaigns, personalized offers, and lifecycle communications.   Customer retention and loyalty: Develop and execute strategies that increase repeat bookings, purchase frequency, customer lifetime value, and revenue from existing customers. title: Renewals Manager
description: About Copado   Copado is the leading DevOps platform for Salesforce, revolutionizing how the world's largest organizations achieve success in their Salesforce deployments. Our mission is to accelerate the Salesforce development lifecycle, support digital transformation, and deliver unparalleled value to our customers. We continuously innovate, ensuring our platform meets the evolving needs of Salesforce developers and operations professionals.   About The Role   We are seeking a proactive, commercially minded Renewals Manager to own and drive the successful renewal of an assigned portfolio of North American customers.  In this customer-facing role, you will build strong relationships, understand customer business objectives, reinforce the value of their Copado partnership, and lead renewal conversations through successful closure. You will own a 120-day rolling renewal forecast, proactively identify and mitigate retention risks, and partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to protect recurring revenue and deliver a positive customer experience.  Success requires strong communication, commercial judgment, disciplined execution, and a genuine commitment to helping customers realize continued value from Copado.   What You'll Do     Own Renewal Outcomes: Manage assigned renewal opportunities from initial engagement through negotiation and closure, maximizing recurring revenue retention and minimizing preventable churn.  Engage Customers Proactively: Initiate and lead customer calls and discovery conversations to understand business priorities, assess renewal intentions, uncover risks, and establish clear, mutually agreed next steps.  Reinforce Customer Value: Partner with Customer Success to understand adoption and business outcomes, helping customers connect Copado's capabilities to their business objectives and justify continued investment.  Manage Your Forecast: Own and continuously manage a 120-day rolling renewal forecast, using customer-validated commitments, identified risks, and actionable next steps to drive forecast accuracy and predictability.  Identify and Mitigate Risk: Proactively address potential churn, contraction, and renewal delays by developing actionable mitigation plans and engaging appropriate stakeholders.  Lead Commercial Negotiations: Prepare renewal proposals, negotiate pricing and contract terms, and navigate customer objections to secure mutually beneficial agreements.  Build Customer Relationships: Develop relationships with key stakeholders, decision-makers, and economic buyers to support successful renewal decisions.  Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Finance to align renewal strategies, resolve challenges, and identify expansion opportunities.  Maintain Operational Discipline: Keep CRM opportunities accurate and current, including forecast status, renewal amounts, close dates, customer risks, and next steps.  Drive Continuous Improvement: Contribute insight

title: Advisory – FAAS Global Payroll Solutions - Implementation Manager – Dublin/Cork
description: Job Description    The Opportunity   Grant Thornton Ireland is seeking a highly organised, proactive and experienced Implementation Manager to join our Global Payroll Solutions team.  The successful candidate will lead complex client implementations, transformation projects and service transitions while supporting the delivery of high-quality global payroll managed services.  This role goes beyond traditional payroll implementation, covering technology deployments, system integrations, process improvements, automation and broader transformation initiatives.  We are looking for a strong communicator and confident leader who can manage multiple projects, coordinate international stakeholders, drive accountability and ensure successful delivery in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.  The role will be split approximately 60% Implementation & Projects and 40% Managed Services.   Key Responsibilities    Implementation and Project Management (60%)      Lead end-to-end client implementations, payroll transitions and transformation projects, from initial planning and requirements gathering through testing, go-live and stabilisation.    Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring effective governance, resource allocation, risk management, budget oversight and timely delivery.    Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, action trackers, status reports and stakeholder communications.    Coordinate internal teams, international Grant Thornton member firms, clients and third-party providers across multiple jurisdictions.    Lead project meetings, workshops and steering committees, ensuring clear decisions, accountability and follow-up.    Proactively identify risks, dependencies and potential delays, driving timely resolution and escalation.    Support technology implementations, integrations, automation and process improvement initiatives.      Managed Services and Client Delivery (40%)      Provide management oversight of global payroll managed services engagements, ensuring delivery against agreed service levels, quality standards and client expectations.    Act as a senior escalation point for operational, technical and cross-border issues.    Monitor service performance, operational risks, internal controls and compliance requirements.    Lead client service reviews and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders.    Ensure smooth transitions from implementation into business-as-usual operations, including documentation, knowledge transfer and governance.    Support service improvements, client retention and opportunities for business growth.      People Leadership and Stakeholder Management      Lead, coach and develop multidisciplinary project and service delivery teams.    Manage workloads, team priorities, capacity planning and quality of deliverables.    Build trusted relationships with clients, senior stakeholders, external providers and international colleagues.    Deliver presentations, workshops, project updates

title: Creative Strategist · Paid Social, KI-native (m/w/d)
description:
Warum es diese Stelle gibt

Infinos ist eine der größten Telemedizin-Plattformen für medizinische Abnehmtherapie in Deutschland. Wir machen einen mittleren 7-stelligen Jahresumsatz und haben bis heute kein Investorengeld genommen. Zwei Gründer, ein Team von rund 8 Leuten, tausende Patienten, die wir jeden Monat begleiten.

Ich bin Linus, einer der beiden Gründer und habe die Creatives für unsere Ads bisher zum großen Teil selbst gemacht. Das Marketing wächst schneller, als ich es neben allem anderen leisten kann. Deshalb suche ich die Person, die diesen Bereich übernimmt und mit uns ausbaut.

Was du machst

  • Den Markt beobachten: was die Konkurrenz in Deutschland und im Ausland schaltet und was im Abnehmmarkt außerhalb der Medizin funktioniert.

  • Daraus testbare Konzepte machen, jeweils mit klarer Hypothese und mehreren Hooks, und davon jede Woche neue an den Start bringen.

  • Creatives selbst bauen, vor allem mit KI: Statics, Animationen und Schnitte aus vorhandenem Material.

  • Drehs organisieren, mit uns Gründern, unserem Team und UGC-Creator, von Briefing und Skript bis zur Abnahme.

  • Auswerten, was läuft und daraus die nächste Runde ableiten.

  • Später dazu: unseren Newsletter und Shortform-Content für TikTok und Reels.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • Woche 1: deine erste eigene Ad ist live.

  • Monat 1: Marktbeobachtung und Ideenplanung laufen über dich und jede Woche gehen neue Tests von dir raus.

  • Monat 3: du gibst deine Ads selbst frei, kennst die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich sicher und hast einen Plan, wie wir organisch auf Shortform wachsen.

Wen wir suchen

  • Du hast schon Creatives für Paid Social gebaut, die gelaufen sind und weißt, warum sie funktioniert haben. Wie groß das Budget dahinter war, ist zweitrangig.

  • Du baust selbst, statt nur zu briefen, und arbe

title: Head of Growth Europa (m/w/d)
description:
10ML ist ein europäischer Parfum-Händler, und die Parfum-Abfüllungen und Proben von 10ML in 3 ml, 10 ml und 30 ml sind ein einfacher Weg, Designer- und Nischendüfte zu entdecken. Als Head of Growth verantwortest du die gesamte Wachstumsmaschine in Europa: Akquise, Conversion, Kundenbindung und Expansion in neue Länder und Kanäle.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Wachstumsstrategie und ihre Kennzahlen: Neukunden, Conversion Rate, durchschnittlicher Bestellwert, Wiederkaufrate und Payback in allen europäischen Märkten

  • Du führst die Verantwortlichen für Performance Marketing, SEO, CRM und Partnerschaften, setzt ihre Ziele und gibst ihnen das Budget, um zu gewinnen

  • Du steuerst ein konsequentes Testing-Programm für Website, Checkout, Angebote und Onboarding

  • Du planst Markteintritte und Lokalisierung in neuen EU-Ländern gemeinsam mit Content, Kundenservice und Operations

  • Du baust Forecasts und Reportings, mit denen die Geschäftsleitung entscheidet, wohin der nächste Euro fließt

  • Du machst Parfum-Abfüllungen von 10ML zum selbstverständlichen Weg, einen Duft vor dem Flakonkauf zu testen

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 8 Jahre in Growth oder Performance Marketing im D2C-E-Commerce, bei Marktplätzen oder Konsumgütermarken, davon mindestens 3 Jahre mit Führungsverantwortung

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge beim profitablen Skalieren bezahlter und organischer Kanäle in mehreren europäischen Ländern

  • Sicher im Umgang mit Unit Economics: CAC, LTV, Deckungsbeitrag, Kohortenbindung

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit GA4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads und Analysen auf SQL-Niveau

  • Fließendes Englisch; Deutsch oder eine weitere EU-Sprache ist ein großes Plus

  • Bonus: Erfahrung in Beauty, Duft, Kosmetik oder Luxus-Retail

Über 10ML

10ML ist ein europäischer Parfum-Händler mit Hauptsitz in Dort

title: Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients: Growth & Expansion
description:
Your Role

As Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients (f/m/d) you own the complete growth loop for LIQID's digitally-led clients: from a newly created lead to the first investment, and from there to the next top-up, the second portfolio and the next product. Acquisition and expansion sit in one team with one mandate, so you build a single growth system instead of handing clients over at the funnel's end. LIQID is hybrid by design: for this segment the experience is digital-first, and you decide precisely where a human touch from our advisors accelerates conversion or growth – and where it doesn't.

What you'll do

  • End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the digital client lifecycle from Lead → Signup → Checkout → First Investment → Activation → Expansion. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree across conversion and expansion – lead-to-funded conversion, time to fund, time to first top-up, multi-product rate, share of wallet – and you are accountable for net new money from the segment, not for a single funnel stage.

  • Lead Conversion & Onboarding Experience: Design and optimize the journeys that turn leads into funded clients – lead nurturing, signup, onboarding and checkout – together with Product Design, Marketing and Sales. You shape the first-product strategy – which entry offer converts which persona – and make sure the brand promise and premium positioning carry through every step that builds trust and drives conversion.

title: Personalsachbearbeiter (m/w/d) HR & Recruiting
description:

Du willst nicht nur Akten pflegen, sondern Menschen begleiten, vom ersten Bewerbungsgespräch bis zum letzten Arbeitstag?
Du bist gerne die Person, an die sich alle mit ihren Fragen wenden?
Dann unterstütze das Team hinter der A1-Falke, vor Ort in Rotenburg (Wümme).

Deine Benefits bei ARGUS Interception

  • Sicherheit: Du bekommst eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit in einem stark wachsenden Hightech-Unternehmen.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust die HR-Prozesse in einem wachsenden Unternehmen aktiv mit aus.

  • Einarbeitung: Du hast einen festen Ansprechpartner und arbeitest in einem motivierten Team.

  • Work-Life-Balance: Du hast flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub.

  • Corporate Benefits: Du hast Zugang zu unseren Corporate Benefits.

  • Teamevents: Wir feiern regelmäßig gemeinsam.

description:
About our client

Our client is an established software company in the field of IT security. For more than two decades, it has been developing solutions for secure digital communication – technology that reliably protects content and identities and keeps unwanted messages and malware at bay, without putting technical hurdles in the way of its users. Several thousand customers from regulated industries such as healthcare, energy, finance and insurance, public administration, pharmaceuticals and law rely on this technology.

The company is rooted in the German-speaking market and is currently growing internationally. Precision, reliability and high standards of quality shape its products just as much as the way people work together. Its core values – openness, reliability, appreciation and competence – apply within the team as much as in dealings with customers and partners.

We are happy to share our client’s name in a personal conversation.


Your mission

You will shape how several companies become one organisation.

Our client is growing – through acquisitions, through internationalisation and through building new structures across Switzerland, Germany, Denmark and further locations. This phase will not be decided by strategy, but by whether the people in our companies come along.

That is exactly what we need you for. As Director People & Culture, you will make sure the upcoming consolidation and integration steps are accepted and consistently implemented across the entire group: structures, roles, leadership, communication and the retention of the people we want to keep. You will report directly to our CEO and work closely with him.

The role is strategic and hands-on at the same time. There is no large HR apparatus behind you – you design the solution and then implement it yourself.

title: Product Owner, Growth
description:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

description:
À propos de Scento

Scento est le plus grand site de décants de parfum d'Europe. Fondée en 2024, l'entreprise a son siège à Paris, place Vendôme, et un second bureau à Berlin. Scento propose en décant plus de 1 000 parfums de créateurs et de niche, tous originaux, issus d'un portefeuille de 200 maisons : flacons de 2 ml, 5 ml et 8 ml, ainsi qu'un flacon de 30 ml pour la plupart des parfums. Le parfum décant permet de découvrir des échantillons de parfum de niche et de grandes maisons avant d'investir dans un flacon entier. Chaque parfum est un original acheté auprès de revendeurs européens agréés, et chaque flacon passe un contrôle d'entrée en 12 points sur le site certifié ISO de Scento avant d'être décanté.

Scento sert des clients dans 27 marchés européens et livre dans 26 pays de l'Union européenne. En 2026, le chiffre d'affaires annuel de Scento dépasse 30 millions d'euros, ventes en ligne et hors ligne confondues. Sur Scento.com, les ventes mensuelles de décants de septembre 2026 représentaient 3,2 fois celles de janvier 2026. Selon Scento, plus de 3 millions de décants de parfum sont vendus chaque année, soit environ un toutes les 10 secondes. En novembre 2025, Scento a annoncé un investissement de 25 millions d'euros sur trois ans dans la découverte du parfum en Europe.

L'acquisition payante est l'un des principaux moteurs de croissance de Scento. Nous vendons des décants de parfum de créateurs et de niche à des clients répartis sur 27 marchés européens, avec des budgets mensuels importants à placer sur Meta, Google et de nouveaux canaux.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe de secrétariat assurant l'accueil et la prise en charge administrative des patients ainsi que l'organisation quotidienne de l'activité des médecins.

Le secrétariat occupe une place essentielle dans le fonctionnement du cabinet : premier et dernier interlocuteur du patient, il contribue directement à la qualité de son accueil et de son parcours de soins.

Dans un environnement dynamique, où les sollicitations sont nombreuses, nous recherchons une personne à l'aise dans la relation avec les patients, organisée, réactive et capable de gérer les priorités avec autonomie.

Vos missions

Au quotidien, vous aurez notamment pour missions de :

  • assurer l'accueil physique et téléphonique des patients et leur orientation ;
  • gérer les agendas, la prise de rendez-vous et les flux d'activité ;
  • créer, mettre à jour et assurer le suivi administratif des dossiers médicaux ;
  • assurer la facturation des consultations et actes médicaux ainsi que les encaissements ;
  • préparer et suivre les documents nécessaires au parcours de soins ;
  • récupérer et intégrer les résultats d'examens dans les dossiers patients ;
  • assurer la frappe et la mise en forme de courriers et comptes rendus médicaux ;
  • organiser les bureaux et préparer les éléments nécessaires aux consultations ;
  • assurer le suivi des stocks et les commandes de consommables et de matériel médical.

L'ensemble de ces missions est exercé dans le respect strict de la confidentialité, du secret professionnel et de l'identitovigilance.

Vos compétences

Une expérience préalable de l'environnement médical est indispensable pour ce poste.

title: Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d)
description:
Du willst nicht einfach irgendeine Code‑Rolle übernehmen. Du willst die technische Gesamtarchitektur von industriellen Bedienoberflächen bestimmen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine UI‑Entwicklung. Hier geht es um Security‑by‑Design nach IEC 62443, Skalierbarkeit und die Integration in komplexe Anlagen.

5 Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung, 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen Position und gelegentliche Kundenreisen sind für dich Normalität.

Unser Kunde

Der Kunde ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen im Bereich Automatisierungstechnik und Maschinenbau, das weltweit industrielle Anlagen und Steuerungssysteme liefert. Mit mehreren Standorten in der Schweiz und Europa entwickelt das Unternehmen integrierte Softwarelösungen, darunter eine einheitliche HMI‑Plattform für seine Produkte. Es positioniert sich als Innovationsführer im Bereich industrieller Bedienoberflächen.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Technische Führungsrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf die Produktarchitektur
  • Arbeit mit Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und Web‑HMI‑Technologien
  • Verantwortung für Security nach IEC 62443 (Benutzerverwaltung, Verschlüsselung)
  • Vielfältige Industrieprojekte von Maschinen‑ bis Anlagenbau
  • Gelegentliche Kundenreisen zur Inbetriebnahme und Feldunterstützung
  • Gestaltung einer einheitlichen, wiederverwendbaren HMI‑Plattform

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwurf, Dokumentation und Weiterentwicklung der HMI‑Softwarearchitektur (Schichten, Module, Schnittstellen)
  • Auswahl und Bewertung von HMI‑Frameworks und Tools (Qt/QML, WinCC Unified, TIA Portal, Web‑HMI)
  • Definition von Architekturprinzipien, Design‑Patterns (z. B. MVVM) und Coding‑Guidelines
  • Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Komponentenbibliotheken und Bedienbausteine
  • Konzeption der Anbindung an Steuerungen über OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus oder MQTT
  • Umsetzung von Security‑by‑Design, Rollen‑ und Rechtekonzepten nach IEC 62443

Binnen het team Planning & Control van Financiële Adviesdiensten is tijdelijke versterking nodig vanwege een hoge werkdruk, het vertrek van een controller en de uitvoering van het programma Financieel Solide, gericht op het versterken van de financiële sturing en de verdere professionalisering van de planning- en-controlfunctie.

Als Senior Business Controller adviseer je management en directie over financiële en bedrijfsmatige vraagstukken. Je levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan de financiële sturing, beheersing en toekomstbestendigheid van een grote publieke uitvoeringsorganisatie. Daarnaast speel je een actieve rol in het verbeteren en standaardiseren van planning- en-controlprocessen.

Deze opdracht is interessant voor professionals met ervaring binnen de rijksoverheid, een agentschap of een grote uitvoeringsorganisatie die impact willen maken op strategische financiële vraagstukken, business control, managementrapportages en organisatiebrede veranderopgaven.

Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you.

Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland)


About Intero Integrity

Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data.

The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement.

We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact.

The opportunity

This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide.

title: Senior Integrity Engineer
description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

title: Senior Operations Manager - ALO
description:

GEODIS heeft zich ten doel gesteld Europees leider te worden in de logistieke dienstverlening. We streven naar Stakeholders Total Satisfaction (STS): totale tevredenheid van onze klanten, medewerkers, partners, maatschappij en aandeelhouders. Onze missie? Klanten succesvol maken door het optimaliseren van hun logistieke processen. Wij zijn experts in transport- en logistieke oplossingen, verenigd door passie, toewijding, innovatie en betrouwbaarheid.

Functieomschrijving

Wil jij bouwen aan een efficiënte, veilige en klantgerichte logistieke operatie voor een toonaangevende fashion-klant? GEODIS zoekt een Senior Operations Manager die dagelijks het verschil maakt in Almere. Bij afwezigheid van de Site Manager neem jij de eindverantwoordelijkheid op de site.

Als Senior Operations Manager geef je direct leiding aan 2-5 Operations Managers/Supervisors en stuur je operationele teams aan. Je bewaakt het operationeel beleid, signaleert verbeterpunten, stuurt op KPI’s en SLA’s, en zorgt voor een gezonde balans tussen kwaliteit, efficiency, kostenbeheersing en medewerkerstevredenheid.

description:
In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het voorbereiden en organiseren van export luchtvrachtzendingen conform de specificatie van de klant en richtlijnen van Geodis.

Je bent het centrale punt in een dynamisch proces. Je communiceert met klanten, leveranciers, kantoren en agenten. Je maakt afspraken met vervoerders en airlines conform de wensen van de klant. Hierbij probeer je proactief te zorgen dat marges worden vergroot zonder dat dit ten koste gaat van de kwaliteit die je levert.

Na een gedegen inwerkperiode zal er sprake zijn van periodieke standby/weekenddiensten.

Daarnaast ligt onze focus op jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling binnen het vakgebied.


Wij zijn op zoek naar een leuke, enthousiaste, leergierige Freight Forwarder met goede kennis van Nederlands en Engels in woord en geschrift. Je bent communicatief vaardig en je hebt gedegen kennis van de Freight Forwarding Industrie. Je hebt MBO+ werkervaring, bent in het bezit van een geldige VGB & MLV en je hebt een probleemoplossende instelling. 

Voor aanvang van het dienstverband zal er een VGB aanvraag worden gestart.

title: Head of Product
description:
As Head of Product, your mission is to lead the product organization that builds what our users bank with every day, ensuring they get the safe, smart and effortless banking they expect.

Why this matters:
At bunq, our mission is to Make Life Easy, for our users, our teams, and the world around us.

Every team plays a unique role in making this mission a reality. The Product team does this by building and improving the products our users bank with, while keeping them safe and compliant.

As Head of Product, you contribute by setting product direction and leading the product leaders who deliver it, helping us grow as the bank of The Free.

Take ownership:
As Head of Product, you’ll take charge of key responsibilities that directly impact bunq’s growth and our users’ seamless experience:

  • Grow our users’ use of bunq’s products by leading product strategy and delivery for your area.

  • Keep growth and safety moving together, so that fraud, compliance and quality are built into the products rather than bolted on.

  • Build a strong, AI-first product organization by leading Product Owners and Team Leads, and redesigning how the function works around AI agents instead of adding headcount by default.

  • Be bunq’s product voice with the management board, regulators, auditors and partners.


  • You’ve led a technical product organization and can get hands-on when needed. Size of organization isn’t the bar.

  • You have product leadership experience in a regulated financial services setting.

  • You understand payments and fraud, and you have data analysis skills and engineering depth.

  • You have experience working with regulators and across multiple markets.

title: Cost Manager (medior/senior)
description:
Ben jij ambitieus, analytisch sterk en klaar voor de volgende stap? Als Cost Manager bij ons advies- en ingenieursbureau werk je aan uitdagende projecten die zichtbaar impact maken. Je bewaakt kosten, adviseert over haalbaarheid en zorgt dat plannen financieel realistisch én toekomstbestendig zijn. Ons bureau is groot genoeg om op topniveau te opereren, maar overzichtelijk genoeg om je echt thuis te voelen. Je krijgt ruimte om te groeien, samen te werken met experts en bij te dragen aan duurzame, innovatieve oplossingen.

De uitdaging 

Binnen onze projecten groeit de behoefte aan betere budgetcontrole en sturing op kosten. Ook het tijdig signaleren en beheersen van financiële en contractuele risico’s gedurende de hele levenscyclus van een project is cruciaal voor succesvol resultaat. Daarom breiden wij ons Cost Management-team uit. We zoeken een ervaren Cost Manager die het team wil versterken, verder helpen groeien tot een zelfstandige unit en zelf een leidende rol ambieert. Als Cost Manager ben je onderdeel van de unit Special Building Consultancy.

Nairon GmbH is a Swiss startup building AI voice agents that answer and make phone calls for businesses. Our platform runs real-time conversations over the phone and on the web, connected to our customers' telephony and business tools. As a Voice AI Engineer at Nairon GmbH, you will make our agents sound fast, natural and reliable in live calls. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Cutting end-to-end latency across speech recognition, language models and speech synthesis, and making provider failover seamless.
  • Optimising how we use LLMs in conversation: prompting, tool calls, streaming and speculative or parallel requests.
  • Serving our own speech models (STT and TTS) on GPUs, measuring throughput and time to first audio.
  • Fine-tuning speech and language models for our customers' languages and voices.
  • Building evaluation: test calls, benchmarks and quality metrics that tell us when a change really helps.

Requirements

Experience:

A senior or strong mid-level engineer with production experience in real-time audio, conversational AI or ML model serving.

Technical Skills:

Required:

  • Strong Python, including asyncio and streaming pipelines.
  • Hands-on work with speech (STT, TTS, VAD) and LLM APIs in latency-sensitive systems.
  • Model serving on GPUs, for example with vLLM or similar, and the basics of batching and memory limits.

title: Freelance Acquisition Paid Media (Google Ads, Meta Ads)
description:
Nous recherchons un(e) consultant(e) freelance spécialisé(e) en acquisition payante pour intervenir sur plusieurs projets e-commerce dans la beauté, la nutrition et la santé.

Notre terrain de jeu : l'acquisition payante nourrie par les contenus de créateurs. Spark Ads, whitelisting, Partnership Ads, amplification de contenus UGC. Si vous savez transformer une vidéo de créatrice en campagne rentable, cette mission est pour vous.

Nous recherchons un partenaire capable aussi bien d'optimiser des dispositifs existants que de construire une stratégie paid media de A à Z pour de nouvelles marques ou de nouveaux marchés. Cette première mission pourra déboucher sur une collaboration récurrente.

Vos missions

1. Audit et optimisation de l'existant

  • Auditer les comptes Google Ads, Meta Ads et TikTok Ads.

  • Identifier les principaux freins à la performance (tracking, structure des campagnes, ciblages, créas, audiences, budget, attribution).

  • Construire un plan d'actions priorisé selon l'impact business, puis le mettre en œuvre.

  • Suivre les performances et formuler de nouvelles recommandations.

2. Amplification des contenus créateurs

  • Sélectionner les contenus UGC et créateurs à fort potentiel publicitaire.

  • Mettre en place les autorisations (Spark Ads, whitelisting, Partnership Ads) avec les créateurs.

  • Tester les hooks, formats et angles, puis industrialiser ce qui performe.

3. Construction d'une stratégie d'acquisition sur un nouveau marché

Sur l'un des projets, vous définirez et déploierez une stratégie d'acquisition payante sur les réseaux sociaux pour accompagner le lancement d'un concept sur le marché américain : choix des plateformes et des formats, architecture des campagnes, audiences, premiers tests, optimisation continue.

title: Product Lead - AI Finance App
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. The Role

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

SAP WM läuft aus, und viele Unternehmen stehen mitten in der Frage: Wie kommen wir sauber von WM auf EWM, ohne dass im Lager etwas stillsteht? Genau hier setzt diese Rolle an. Die Rolle

Du gestaltest die Transformation bestehender SAP-WM-Lagerlandschaften hin zu SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) und verantwortest Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung der Lagerlogistik-Prozesse, von der Lagerstruktur über Wareneingang und Warenausgang bis zur Bestandsführung. Dabei verbindest du fundiertes Know-how in SAP WM und EWM mit Prozessverständnis in der Lagerlogistik. Du entwickelst integrierte End-to-End-Lösungen, begleitest Konzeption und Umsetzung und übernimmst Verantwortung in anspruchsvollen Logistik- und Migrationsprojekten.

The Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & Data Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end handling, quality assurance, accessibility, and long-term management of all flight data. The primary objective is to ensure that full-aircraft data, from the onboard sensors and DAQ systems to the final processing tools, is available to every engineering team through a reliable, efficient, and standardized workflow.

Tasks

Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & DAQ Pipeline

  • Manage the data pipeline from the physical sensor and Data Acquisition (DAQ) level for the full aircraft, ensuring seamless and accurate transmission into the telemetry and storage systems.

  • Collaborate with hardware, software and integration teams to define sensor requirements, DAQ architectures, scaling, and telemetry bandwidth allocations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data anomalies at the DAQ and sensor level (e.g., signal noise, dropouts, faulty scaling) before they propagate into downstream databases.

Data Infrastructure & Accessibility

  • Maintain reliable extraction of flight data from InfluxDB.
  • Develop and maintain standardized local data structures for analysis, plotting, and visualization.
  • Optimize access to large flight datasets while minimizing CPU and memory usage.
  • Design and maintain an efficient local storage solution for processed flight data.
  • Support future improvements to the flight data architecture as storage requirements, sensor counts, and analysis needs continue to evolve.

Data Quality & Analysis Support

  • Maintain derived datasets to ensure common calculations and signals are shared consistently across teams.
  • Ensure strict timing sync

Créée en 2004 par Alain Marty, fondateur du Cercle Wine Business, In Vino Radio est aujourd’hui la seule émission de radio au monde entièrement consacrée à l’actualité des vins et spiritueux.

Diffusée chaque week-end sur Sud Radio, l’émission réunit les grandes voix du secteur viticole et gastronomique. Alain Marty y co-anime les émissions aux côtés de journalistes et experts reconnus tels qu’Hélène Piot (Régal), Laure Gasparotto (Le Monde) et Philippe Faure-Brac, Meilleur Sommelier du Monde 1992. Depuis sa création, plus de 1 200 personnalités du monde économique, viticole et gastronomique ont été interviewées. L’émission s’appuie également sur un réseau d’une quarantaine de journalistes et spécialistes du vin.

Dans le cadre de son développement, In Vino Radio recherche un(e) stagiaire Assistant(e) Chef de projet à partir de septembre 2026.

Vos missions

Vos missions

Sous la responsabilité de la rédactrice en chef, vous participerez activement à la préparation des émissions, à la communication digitale ainsi qu’à l’organisation des événements liés à In Vino Radio.

Préparation éditoriale des émissions

  • Assurer une veille sur l’actualité des vins et spiritueux afin d’identifier de nouveaux sujets et invités
  • Contacter des vignerons, cavistes, sommeliers et experts du vin dans toute la France pour organiser des interviews
  • Participer à la programmation des émissions et à la gestion du planning des enregistrements
  • Préparer les dossiers éditoriaux destinés à Alain Marty, aux co-animateurs et aux journalistes intervenants

Communication & réseaux sociaux

  • Participer à la création de contenus vidéo, notamment pour TikTok
  • Animer les réseaux sociaux de l’émission (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok)
  • Concevoir des contenus engageants

Effitech est un laboratoire spécialisé dans les essais mécaniques et métallurgiques ainsi que les contrôles non destructifs (CND) à destination d’industries exigeantes, notamment le nucléaire, la défense et l’énergie.

title: Conseiller commercial VEFA H/F
description:
INOVEFA, acteur reconnu des services immobiliers depuis 2012, regroupe cinq entités complémentaires au service des promoteurs, des investisseurs et des particuliers. Dans le cadre du développement de son pôle INOVEFA Vente, spécialisé dans la commercialisation de programmes immobiliers neufs (VEFA), l’entreprise recrute un(e) Conseiller(ère) Commercial(e) terrain pour accompagner les acquéreurs tout au long de leur projet immobilier.

Vos missions

En tant que Conseiller(ère) Commercial(e), vous assurez des permanences sur site (bulle de vente) sur la région lyonnaise.   • Participation frais de transports publics

title: AI Engineer

We are a small technical team, founded out of ETH Zürich and MIT, and we are looking for engineers who want to work on frontier AI in a domain where it has barely arrived.

Tasks

  • Build and improve the agents that turn captured reality into finished documentation
  • Work on the perception and semantic layer that recognises components and structures in 3D

Requirements

title: Consultant Revenue Management H/F
description:
Spécialiste du revenue management externalisé depuis 18 ans, Xperteo accompagne des groupes hôteliers et établissements indépendants dans l’optimisation de leur performance.

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) Consultant(e) Revenue Management & Distribution expérimenté(e).

Vos missions

Rattaché(e) à votre Team Leader, vous êtes responsable de la performance revenue et distribution d’un portefeuille d’hôtels.

Véritable partenaire stratégique des établissements, vous intervenez à la fois sur le pilotage opérationnel et le conseil.

Pilotage d’un portefeuille hôtels :

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie tarifaire et de distribution
  • Analyser la performance : occupation, ADR, RevPAR, pick-up, paceSuivre et optimiser les résultats au quotidien
  • Fixer les objectifs mensuels et annuels avec les clients
  • Identifier les leviers de croissance et recommander des actions concrètes

Relation client & conseil

  • Être l’interlocuteur(trice) privilégié(e) des hôtels
  • Animer des points réguliers avec les directeurs et exploitants
  • Construire une relation de confiance dans une logique de partenariat long terme
  • Garantir la satisfaction client et la reconduction des contrats

Distribution & outils

  • Piloter le channel management et la visibilité en ligne
  • Gérer et contrôler les mises à jour sur PMS, RMS, Channel Manager, OTA
  • Assurer une utilisation optimale des outils métiers

Reporting & recommandations

  • Produire des analyses régulières et des reportings stratégiques
  • Formuler des recommandations argumentées et actionnables

title: Contrôleur CND F/H
description:
À propos d’Effitech

Effitech est un laboratoire spécialisé dans les essais mécaniques et métallurgiques ainsi que les contrôles non destructifs (CND) à destination d’industries exigeantes, notamment le nucléaire, la défense et l’énergie.

Nous accompagnons nos clients sur des prestations critiques telles que :

  • Essais destructifs : traction, flexion, résilience, dureté
  • Contrôles non destructifs : ressuage (PT), magnétoscopie (MT) et ultrasons (UT)
  • Analyses métallurgiques et expertises techniques

Dans un contexte de forte croissance, nous recherchons un contrôleur CND.

Missions

Rattaché au pôle CND, vous êtes en charge de réaliser les contrôles non destructifs et d’émettre un rapport jugeant de la conformité du lot contrôlé.

Gestion des affaires

  • Suivre les affaires jusqu’à la livraison (délais, qualité, satisfaction client)

Relation client & technique

  • Être l’interface avec le client et le cas échéant avec les inspecteurs
  • Garantir la bonne compréhension des exigences (Procédures, normes, RCC-M,)
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue

Profil recherché

Formation & expérience

  • Bac à Bac+3 technique (des certifications COFREND seraient un plus)
  • Expérience souhaitée en environnement industriel (laboratoire, métallurgie, contrôle, qualité…)

Compétences clés

  • Bonne compréhension des procédés industriels et des matériaux
  • Connaissance des CND (PT, MT) et/ou essais mécaniques appréciée
  • Capacité à lire un plan technique et des spécifications clients
  • Culture qualité (ISO 9001 / ISO 17025 / ISO 19443 est un plus)

Qualités personnelles
